   PHASE 2.1 — CONSTITUTION PANEL
   Compact SOUL.MD article status bar at the
   bottom of the right sidebar. Article chips
   colour by last check result; violations log
   to the activity feed.
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.const-panel{
  flex-shrink:0;
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  padding:10px 12px 12px;
  background:rgba(124,58,237,0.03);
}
.const-header{
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  margin-bottom:8px;
}
.const-title{
  font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:9.5px;
  text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.09em;
  color:var(--neuro);
}
.const-meta{
  font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:9px;
  color:var(--text-dim);
}
.const-chips{
  display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:4px;
}
.const-chip{
  font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:8px;
  border-radius:4px; padding:1px 6px;
  border:1px solid; cursor:default;
  transition:all .2s;
}
.const-chip.clear  { color:var(--pulse);    border-color:rgba(16,185,129,0.4);  background:rgba(16,185,129,0.08);  }
.const-chip.block  { color:var(--critical); border-color:rgba(239,68,68,0.4);   background:rgba(239,68,68,0.08);   }
.const-chip.idle   { color:var(--text-dim); border-color:var(--border);          background:transparent; }
.const-last{
  font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:8.5px;
  color:var(--text-dim); margin-top:6px;
}
.const-last.ok   { color:var(--pulse); }
.const-last.warn { color:var(--critical); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE — collapse sidebars below 1100px
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .app {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: var(--top-h) var(--tab-h) 1fr;
    grid-template-areas:
      "topbar"
      "main"
      "main";
  }
  .left-sidebar, .right-sidebar {
    position: fixed;
    top: var(--top-h);
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 50;
    width: 290px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    transform: translateX(-100%);
    transition: transform 0.22s ease;
  }
  .left-sidebar { left: 0; }
  .right-sidebar { right: 0; transform: translateX(100%); }
  .left-sidebar.open  { transform: translateX(0); }
  .right-sidebar.open { transform: translateX(0); }
  .main { grid-area: 2 / 1 / 4 / 2; }
  .global-health { display: none; }
  .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">

  <!-- ══ TOP BAR ══ -->
  <header class="topbar">
    <div class="brand">
      <!-- DNA double-helix icon — SVG inline -->
      <svg class="brand-icon" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <path d="M8 4 Q16 10 24 4" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <path d="M8 28 Q16 22 24 28" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <path d="M8 4 Q2 16 8 28" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <path d="M24 4 Q30 16 24 28" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <!-- rungs -->
        <line x1="9.5"  y1="9.5"  x2="22.5" y2="9.5"  stroke="#4a5470" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/>
        <line x1="7.2"  y1="16"   x2="24.8" y2="16"   stroke="#4a5470" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/>
        <line x1="9.5"  y1="22.5" x2="22.5" y2="22.5" stroke="#4a5470" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/>
        <!-- node dots -->
        <circle cx="8"  cy="4"  r="2" fill="#7c3aed"/>
        <circle cx="24" cy="4"  r="2" fill="#7c3aed"/>
        <circle cx="8"  cy="28" r="2" fill="#7c3aed"/>
        <circle cx="24" cy="28" r="2" fill="#7c3aed"/>
        <circle cx="7.2"  cy="16" r="1.5" fill="#10b981"/>
        <circle cx="24.8" cy="16" r="1.5" fill="#10b981"/>
      </svg>
      <div class="brand-text">
        <span class="brand-name">Sovereign Hive</span>
        <span class="brand-sub">biosystem architecture · 72 systems</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- global health summary (hidden on mobile) -->
    <div class="global-health" id="globalHealth">
      <div class="health-metric">
        <div class="dot pulse"></div>
        <span class="label">Active</span>
        <span class="count" id="countActive">0</span>
      </div>
      <div class="health-metric">
        <div class="dot warn"></div>
        <span class="label">Limited</span>
        <span class="count" id="countLimited">0</span>
      </div>
      <div class="health-metric">
        <div class="dot critical"></div>
        <span class="label">Offline</span>
        <span class="count" id="countOffline">0</span>
      </div>
      <div class="health-metric">
        <div class="dot idle"></div>
        <span class="label">Idle</span>
        <span class="count" id="countIdle">55</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="topbar-right">
      <!-- Phase 10: utility buttons -->
      <button class="topbar-util-btn" id="helpBtn" title="Help & Configuration">?</button>
      <button class="topbar-util-btn" id="exportBtn" title="Export Hive state to JSON">⬡ Export</button>
      <!-- AZR cycle indicator -->
      <div class="azr-indicator" id="azrIndicator" title="Absolute Zero Reasoner — click or type 'evolve'">
        <span class="azr-label">AZR</span>
        <span class="azr-cycle" id="azrCycle">0</span>
        <span class="azr-step" id="azrStep">IDLE</span>
      </div>
      <div class="rho-indicator" id="rhoIndicator" title="Hive Resonance">
        <span class="rho-label">ρ</span>
        <span class="rho-value" id="rhoValue">—</span>
        <span class="rho-tag" id="rhoTag">IDLE</span>
      </div>
      <span class="system-clock" id="clock">00:00:00</span>
      <button class="mobile-menu-btn" id="mobileLeftBtn">☰ Systems</button>
      <button class="mobile-menu-btn" id="mobileRightBtn">☰ Log</button>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- ══ LEFT SIDEBAR ══ -->
  <aside class="left-sidebar" id="leftSidebar">
    <div class="sidebar-header">
      <span class="sidebar-title">Systems</span>
      <span class="sidebar-badge" id="sidebarBadge">72 registered</span>
    </div>

    <nav class="sys-nav" id="sysNav">
      <!-- populated by JS from SYSTEM_REGISTRY -->
    </nav>

    <!-- ══ PHASE 2.4 — SOUL ECONOMY PANEL ══ -->
    <div class="economy-panel" id="economyPanel">
      <div class="econ-header">
        <span class="econ-title">◈ SOUL Economy</span>
        <span class="econ-rate" id="econRate">$0.10/SOUL</span>
      </div>
      <div class="econ-row">
        <span class="econ-label">Circulation</span>
        <span class="econ-value gold" id="econCirc">0.00 ◈</span>
      </div>
      <div class="econ-row">
        <span class="econ-label">Treasury</span>
        <span class="econ-value" id="econTreasury">0.00 ◈</span>
      </div>
      <div class="econ-row">
        <span class="econ-label">Trust</span>
        <span class="econ-value" id="econTrust">0.00 ◈</span>
      </div>
      <!-- 70/20/10 distribution bar -->
      <div class="econ-dist" title="Agent 70% · Treasury 20% · Trust 10%">
        <div class="econ-dist-agent"    id="econSegAgent"    style="width:70%"></div>
        <div class="econ-dist-treasury" id="econSegTreasury" style="width:20%"></div>
        <div class="econ-dist-trust"    id="econSegTrust"    style="width:10%"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="econ-dist-labels">
        <span>Agent 70%</span><span>Treasury 20%</span><span>Trust 10%</span>
      </div>
      <div class="econ-leader" id="econLeader">⬡ Top earner: —</div>
    </div>

    <div class="sidebar-footer">
      <div class="hive-status-line">
        <div class="dot idle" id="hiveStatusDot"></div>
        <span id="hiveStatusText">All systems idle — awaiting activation</span>
      </div>
      <div class="hive-status-bar" id="hiveStatusBar">
        <div class="seg s-active"  style="width:0%"></div>
        <div class="seg s-limited" style="width:0%"></div>
        <div class="seg s-offline" style="width:0%"></div>
        <div class="seg s-idle"    style="width:100%"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </aside>

  <!-- ══ MAIN CONTENT ══ -->
  <main class="main">

    <!-- ══ PHASE 3 — COGNITIVE MODE BAR ══ -->
    <div class="mode-bar" id="modeBar">
      <!-- populated by renderModeBar() during init -->
    </div>

    <!-- ECG tab strip -->
    <div class="tab-strip" id="tabStrip" role="tablist">
      <button class="tab active" data-tab="brain" role="tab" aria-selected="true">
        <svg class="tab-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8">
          <path d="M9.5 2A6.5 6.5 0 0 1 16 8.5c0 1.5-.5 2.9-1.3 4H16a5 5 0 1 1 0 10H9a7 7 0 1 1 .5-14Z"/>
        </svg>
        Brain
        <span class="tab-count">23</span>
      </button>
      <button class="tab" data-tab="body" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
        <svg class="tab-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8">
          <circle cx="12" cy="5" r="2.5"/>
          <path d="M12 7.5v9M8 10h8M9 20l3-3.5 3 3.5"/>
        </svg>
        Body
        <span class="tab-count">49</span>
      </button>
      <button class="tab" data-tab="neuro" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
        <svg class="tab-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8">
          <path d="M2 12h2M5 6l1.5 1.5M5 18l1.5-1.5M12 2v2M18 6l-1.5 1.5M22 12h-2M18 18l-1.5-1.5M12 20v2"/>
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/>
        </svg>
        Neuro
        <span class="tab-count">6</span>
      </button>
      <button class="tab" data-tab="health" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
        <svg class="tab-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8">
          <path d="M22 12h-4l-3 9L9 3l-3 9H2"/>
        </svg>
        Health
        <span class="tab-count">72</span>
      </button>
      <button class="tab" data-tab="freq" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
        <svg class="tab-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8">
          <path d="M2 12h3l3-8 4 16 3-8h3"/>
        </svg>
        Freq
        <span class="tab-counter" id="tabCountFreq">4</span>
      </button>
      <button class="tab" data-tab="mycel" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
        <svg class="tab-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8">
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>
          <path d="M12 2C6.5 2 2 6.5 2 12M22 12C22 17.5 17.5 22 12 22"/>
          <path d="M12 9C9 9 2 10 2 12s7 3 10 3M12 15c3 0 10-1 10-3s-7-3-10-3"/>
        </svg>
        Mycel
        <span class="tab-counter" id="tabCountMycel">72</span>
      </button>
      <button class="tab" data-tab="kb" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
        <svg class="tab-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8">
          <path d="M12 2l3 7h7l-5.5 4 2 7L12 16l-6.5 4 2-7L2 9h7z"/>
        </svg>
        KB
        <span class="tab-counter" id="tabCountKB">0</span>
      </button>
      <button class="tab" data-tab="sec" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
        <svg class="tab-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8">
          <path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/>
        </svg>
        Sec
        <span class="tab-counter" id="tabCountSec">0</span>
      </button>
      <button class="tab" data-tab="sov" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
        <svg class="tab-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8">
          <path d="M3 7l9-4 9 4M3 7v10l9 4 9-4V7M3 7l9 4 9-4M12 11v10"/>
        </svg>
        Sov
        <span class="tab-counter" id="tabCountSov">5</span>
      </button>
      <button class="tab" data-tab="azr" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
        <svg class="tab-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8">
          <path d="M12 2v4M12 18v4M4.93 4.93l2.83 2.83M16.24 16.24l2.83 2.83M2 12h4M18 12h4M4.93 19.07l2.83-2.83M16.24 7.76l2.83-2.83"/>
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>
        </svg>
        AZR
        <span class="tab-counter" id="tabCountAZR">0</span>
      </button>
      <!-- sliding underline -->
      <div class="tab-underline" id="tabUnderline"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Tab panels -->
    <div class="tab-panels">

      <div class="tab-panel active" id="panel-brain" role="tabpanel">
        <!-- populated by renderBrainMap() during init -->
      </div>

      <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-body" role="tabpanel">
        <!-- populated by renderBodyMap() during init -->
      </div>

      <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-neuro" role="tabpanel">
        <!-- populated by renderNeuroDashboard() during init -->
      </div>

      <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-health" role="tabpanel">
        <!-- populated by renderHealthDashboard() during init -->
      </div>

      <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-freq" role="tabpanel">
        <!-- populated by renderFreqTab() during init -->
      </div>

      <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-mycel" role="tabpanel">
        <!-- populated by renderMycelTab() during init -->
      </div>

      <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-kb" role="tabpanel">
        <!-- populated by renderKBTab() during init -->
      </div>

      <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-sec" role="tabpanel">
        <!-- populated by renderSecTab() during init -->
      </div>

      <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-sov" role="tabpanel">
        <!-- populated by renderSovTab() during init -->
      </div>

      <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-azr" role="tabpanel">
        <!-- populated by renderAZRTab() during init -->
      </div>

    </div>

    <!-- ══ PHASE 2 — PERSISTENT COMMAND BAR ══ -->
    <div class="cmd-bar" id="cmdBar">
      <div class="cmd-status">
        <span class="cmd-dot demo" id="cmdDot"></span>
        <span id="cmdLabel">Demo Mode — backend offline</span>
        <span class="cmd-rho-display" id="cmdRhoDisplay">ρ = —</span>
      </div>
      <div class="cmd-input-row">
        <input type="text" class="cmd-input" id="cmdInput"
               placeholder="Dispatch a task to the Hive swarm… (Enter or ⬡)"
               autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"/>
        <button class="btn btn-primary" id="cmdDispatch">⬡ Dispatch</button>
      </div>
      <!-- live frequency readout -->
      <div class="cmd-freq-display" id="cmdFreqDisplay">
        <span class="freq-word" id="freqWord"></span>
        <span class="freq-divider">→</span>
        <span class="freq-hz" id="freqHz"></span>
        <span class="freq-ratio" id="freqRatio"></span>
      </div>
      <!-- healing frequency shortcuts -->
      <div class="freq-heal-row" id="freqHealRow" style="display:none">
        <span class="freq-heal-label">Heal:</span>
        <span class="freq-heal-chip" data-state="anxiety">Anxiety 528Hz</span>
        <span class="freq-heal-chip" data-state="fear">Fear 396Hz</span>
        <span class="freq-heal-chip" data-state="anger">Anger 417Hz</span>
        <span class="freq-heal-chip" data-state="pain">Pain 174Hz</span>
        <span class="freq-heal-chip" data-state="love">Love 528Hz</span>
      </div>
    </div>

  </main>

  <!-- ══ RIGHT SIDEBAR — ACTIVITY LOG ══ -->
  <aside class="right-sidebar" id="rightSidebar">
    <div class="log-header">
      <span class="log-title">Activity Log</span>
      <button class="log-clear-btn" id="clearLogBtn">clear</button>
    </div>
    <div class="log-body" id="logBody"></div>
    <div class="log-footer">
      <span class="log-counter" id="logCounter">0 events</span>
    </div>

    <!-- ══ PHASE 2.1 — SOUL.MD CONSTITUTION PANEL ══ -->
    <div class="const-panel" id="constitutionPanel">
      <div class="const-header">
        <span class="const-title">⬡ SOUL.MD</span>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center">
          <span class="const-meta" id="constMeta">6 articles · 0 checks</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="const-chips" id="constChips"></div>
      <div class="const-last" id="constLast">No dispatches yet</div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══ PHASE 2.3 — GLADIATOR ARENA PANEL ══ -->
    <div class="arena-panel" id="arenaPanel">
      <div class="arena-header">
        <span class="arena-title">⚔ Arena</span>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center">
          <span class="arena-meta" id="arenaMeta">0 battles</span>
          <button class="arena-quick-btn" id="arenaQuickBtn" title="Random duel">⚔ Duel</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="arena-slots" id="arenaSlots">
        <div class="arena-empty">No challenges yet — type "challenge X vs Y" or press Duel</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </aside>

</div><!-- /.app -->

<script>
(function(){
'use strict';

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   SYSTEM REGISTRY — single source of truth
   Tasks 1.2–1.5, Phase 2 classes, Phase 3 docs
   all read from this object.
   status: 'active' | 'limited' | 'offline' | 'idle'
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

];

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   ACTIVITY LOG
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let logCount = 0;

function log(text, level = 'info'){
  const body  = document.getElementById('logBody');
  const counter = document.getElementById('logCounter');
  const now   = new Date();
  const ts    = `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2,'0')}`;

  const entry = document.createElement('div');
  entry.className = `log-entry lvl-${level}`;
  entry.innerHTML = `<span class="log-ts">${ts}</span><span>${escapeHtml(text)}</span>`;
  body.prepend(entry);
  while(body.children.length > 300) body.removeChild(body.lastChild);

  logCount++;
  counter.textContent = `${logCount} event${logCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
}

document.getElementById('clearLogBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  document.getElementById('logBody').innerHTML = '';
  logCount = 0;
  document.getElementById('logCounter').textContent = '0 events';
  log('Log cleared.', 'info');
});

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   SIDEBAR NAV — built from SYSTEM_REGISTRY
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const GROUP_LABELS = {
  brain: 'Brain Systems',
  body:  'Body Systems'
};

function buildSidebarNav(){
  const nav = document.getElementById('sysNav');
  nav.innerHTML = '';

  Object.entries(SYSTEM_REGISTRY).forEach(([cat, systems]) => {
    const group = document.createElement('div');
    group.className = 'sys-group';

    const header = document.createElement('div');
    header.className = 'sys-group-header';
    header.innerHTML = `
      <span class="sys-group-label">${GROUP_LABELS[cat]}</span>
      <span class="sys-group-count">${systems.length}</span>`;

    const body = document.createElement('div');
    body.className = 'sys-group-body expanded';
    body.id = `sysGroup-${cat}`;

    header.addEventListener('click', () => {
      body.classList.toggle('expanded');
      body.classList.toggle('collapsed');
    });

    systems.forEach(sys => {
      const item = document.createElement('div');
      item.className = 'sys-item';
      item.dataset.sysId = sys.id;
      item.innerHTML = `
        <div class="sys-item-dot s-${sys.status}" id="sidebarDot-${sys.id}"></div>
        <span class="sys-item-name">${escapeHtml(sys.name)}</span>
        <span class="sys-item-analog">${escapeHtml(sys.analog)}</span>`;
      item.addEventListener('click', () => selectSystem(sys.id, cat));
      body.appendChild(item);
    });

    group.appendChild(header);
    group.appendChild(body);
    nav.appendChild(group);
  });
}

function selectSystem(id, cat){
  document.querySelectorAll('.sys-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
  const el = document.querySelector(`.sys-item[data-sys-id="${id}"]`);
  if(el) el.classList.add('active');
  const tab = cat === 'brain' ? 'brain' : 'body';
  activateTab(tab);
  log(`Selected: ${id} (${cat})`, 'info');
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   TAB NAVIGATION — ECG sliding underline
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const tabs    = document.querySelectorAll('.tab');
const panels  = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel');
const underline = document.getElementById('tabUnderline');

function positionUnderline(tab){
  const strip = document.getElementById('tabStrip');
  const stripRect = strip.getBoundingClientRect();
  const tabRect   = tab.getBoundingClientRect();
  underline.style.left  = (tabRect.left - stripRect.left) + 'px';
  underline.style.width = tabRect.width + 'px';
}

function activateTab(tabId){
  tabs.forEach(t => {
    const active = t.dataset.tab === tabId;
    t.classList.toggle('active', active);
    t.setAttribute('aria-selected', active);
    if(active) positionUnderline(t);
  });
  panels.forEach(p => p.classList.toggle('active', p.id === `panel-${tabId}`));
}

tabs.forEach(tab => {
  tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
    activateTab(tab.dataset.tab);
    log(`Switched to ${tab.dataset.tab.toUpperCase()} tab`, 'info');
  });
});

// position underline on first render + window resize
window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  const activeTab = document.querySelector('.tab.active');
  if(activeTab) positionUnderline(activeTab);
});
// defer to after layout paint
requestAnimationFrame(() => {
  const activeTab = document.querySelector('.tab.active');
  if(activeTab) positionUnderline(activeTab);
});

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   GLOBAL HEALTH COUNTERS
   Updated by HiveHealthBus (Task 2.7).
   For now: reads current status from registry.
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function updateHealthCounts(){
  const counts = { active:0, limited:0, offline:0, idle:0 };
  ALL_SYSTEMS.forEach(s => { counts[s.status] = (counts[s.status] || 0) + 1; });
  document.getElementById('countActive').textContent  = counts.active;
  document.getElementById('countLimited').textContent = counts.limited;
  document.getElementById('countOffline').textContent = counts.offline;
  document.getElementById('countIdle').textContent    = counts.idle;

  // status bar
  const total = ALL_SYSTEMS.length;
  const bar = document.getElementById('hiveStatusBar');
  bar.children[0].style.width  = (counts.active  / total * 100) + '%';
  bar.children[1].style.width  = (counts.limited / total * 100) + '%';
  bar.children[2].style.width  = (counts.offline / total * 100) + '%';
  bar.children[3].style.width  = (counts.idle    / total * 100) + '%';

  // hive status dot and text
  const dot  = document.getElementById('hiveStatusDot');
  const text = document.getElementById('hiveStatusText');
  if(counts.offline > 0){
    dot.className = 'dot critical'; text.textContent = `${counts.offline} system(s) offline`;
  } else if(counts.active > 0){
    dot.className = 'dot pulse'; text.textContent = `${counts.active} system(s) active`;
  } else {
    dot.className = 'dot idle'; text.textContent = 'All systems idle — awaiting activation';
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════

══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function tickClock(){
  const now = new Date();
  const h = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2,'0');
  const m = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
  const s = String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('clock').textContent = `${h}:${m}:${s}`;
}
setInterval(tickClock, 1000);
tickClock();

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   HELPERS
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function escapeHtml(s){
  return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c =>
    ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
}

  { label:'Memory & Emotion',         ids:['hippocampus','amygdala'] },

  { label:'Neurotransmitter Systems', ids:['dopamine','serotonin','norepi','acetyl','gaba','glutamate'] }

// MSV (Metacognitive State Vector) dimensions — from Courchaine et al. ACM 2026
const MSV_DIMS = [
  { key:'emotional',    label:'EMO', color:'#7c3aed', title:'Emotional Response' },
  { key:'correctness',  label:'COR', color:'#4fd1c5', title:'Correctness Evaluation' },
  { key:'experiential', label:'EXP', color:'#f59e0b', title:'Experiential Match' },
  { key:'conflicting',  label:'CON', color:'#ef4444', title:'Conflicting Information' },
  { key:'importance',   label:'IMP', color:'#f0a830', title:'Problem Importance' }
];

// Three-hat security posture display labels
const SEC_POSTURES = {
  white:{ icon:'🛡', label:'Secured',     cls:'white' },
  black:{ icon:'⚔',  label:'Compromised', cls:'black' },
  grey: { icon:'◈',  label:'Testing',     cls:'grey'  }
};

/* ── Initialize extended fields on brain registry ── */
function initBrainSystemData(){
  const rnd = (a,b) => Math.floor(Math.random()*(b-a+1))+a;
  SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.forEach(sys => {
    if(!sys.msv) sys.msv = {
      emotional:    rnd(30,80), correctness:  rnd(40,88),
      experiential: rnd(25,75), conflicting:  rnd(8,50),
      importance:   rnd(38,92)
    };
    if(!sys.security)     sys.security     = 'white';
    if(!sys.dependencies) sys.dependencies = BRAIN_DEPS[sys.id] || [];
    if(!sys.interactions) sys.interactions = 0;
  });
}

/* ── Build MSV indicator HTML ── */
function buildMSVHTML(msv){
  // 5 dims: first 4 in 2×2 grid, last spanning full width
  let out = '<div class="brain-card-msv">';
  MSV_DIMS.forEach((d,i) => {
    const v = msv[d.key] || 0;
    const cls = i === 4 ? 'msv-row msv-last' : 'msv-row';
    out += `<div class="${cls}" title="${escapeHtml(d.title)}: ${v}%">
      <span class="msv-lbl">${d.label}</span>
      <div class="msv-track"><div class="msv-fill" style="width:${v}%;background:${d.color}"></div></div>
      <span class="msv-pct">${v}%</span>
    </div>`;
  });
  out += '</div>';
  return out;
}

/* ── Build dependency chip HTML ── */
function buildDepsHTML(deps){
  if(!deps || deps.length === 0) return '';
  const sysMap = {};
  SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.forEach(s => { sysMap[s.id] = s; });
  const visible = deps.slice(0,3);
  const chips = visible.map(id => {
    const s = sysMap[id];
    return s ? `<span class="dep-chip" title="Needs ${escapeHtml(s.name)}">${escapeHtml(s.name.split(' ')[0])}</span>` : '';
  }).join('');
  const overflow = deps.length > 3 ? `<span class="dep-chip">+${deps.length-3}</span>` : '';
  if(!chips && !overflow) return '';
  return `<div class="brain-card-deps">${chips}${overflow}</div>`;
}

/* ── Build a single brain card ── */
function buildBrainCard(sys){
  const st    = sys.status || 'idle';
  const stLbl = st.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + st.slice(1);
  const sp    = SEC_POSTURES[sys.security || 'white'];
  const desc  = BRAIN_DESCRIPTIONS[sys.id] || 'No description available.';

  return `<div class="brain-card" data-sys-id="${escapeHtml(sys.id)}">
    <div class="brain-card-header">
      <span class="brain-card-name">${escapeHtml(sys.name)}</span>
      <span class="status-badge ${escapeHtml(st)}">${escapeHtml(stLbl)}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="brain-card-analog">⬡ ${escapeHtml(sys.analog)}</div>
    <div class="brain-card-desc">${escapeHtml(desc)}</div>
    <div class="brain-card-divider"></div>
    ${buildMSVHTML(sys.msv)}
    <div class="brain-card-footer">
      <span class="security-badge ${sp.cls}">${sp.icon} ${escapeHtml(sp.label)}</span>
      ${buildDepsHTML(sys.dependencies)}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

/* ── Main brain map render ──
   Builds full innerHTML of #panel-brain from registry.
   Called once on init, and again after full security cycles
   that change MSV values beyond what refreshBrainCards() covers.
══ */
function renderBrainMap(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-brain');
  if(!panel) return;

  const sysMap = {};
  SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.forEach(s => { sysMap[s.id] = s; });

  let html = '';

  // Research provenance bar
  html += `<div class="brain-research-bar">
    <span class="research-badge">⬡ Recursive self-improvement hooked</span>
    <span class="research-badge">⬡ MSV metacognitive tracking (Courchaine et al. 2026)</span>
    <span class="research-badge">⬡ Three-hat security posture monitoring</span>
  </div>`;

  // Security toolbar — mock simulation only, no real exploit code
  html += `<div class="brain-toolbar">
    <button class="btn" id="btnWhiteHat" title="Run defensive audit simulation">🛡 White Hat Scan</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btnBlackHat" title="Run adversarial simulation (mock)">⚔ Black Hat Sim</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btnGreyHat"  title="Run boundary test simulation">◈ Grey Hat Test</button>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="btnSecCycle" title="Run full three-hat cycle">↺ Full Cycle</button>
  </div>`;

  html += `<div class="section-heading">Brain Systems
    <span style="font-weight:400;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9.5px;margin-left:8px;color:var(--text-dim);">
      23 components · ${BRAIN_GROUPS.length} regions
    </span>
  </div>`;

  BRAIN_GROUPS.forEach(group => {
    const systems = group.ids.map(id => sysMap[id]).filter(Boolean);
    if(systems.length === 0) return;
    html += `<div class="brain-group-header">
      <span class="g-bar"></span>
      ${escapeHtml(group.label)}
      <span class="g-count">${systems.length}</span>
    </div>`;
    html += `<div class="brain-grid">`;
    systems.forEach(sys => { html += buildBrainCard(sys); });
    html += `</div>`;
  });

  panel.innerHTML = html;

  // ── Card click handlers ──
  panel.querySelectorAll('.brain-card').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('click', () => {
      panel.querySelectorAll('.brain-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
      card.classList.add('selected');
      const id = card.dataset.sysId;
      selectSystem(id, 'brain');
      BrainMapSelfImprovement.recordInteraction(id);
    });
  });

  // ── Toolbar handlers ──
  const wh = document.getElementById('btnWhiteHat');
  const bh = document.getElementById('btnBlackHat');
  const gh = document.getElementById('btnGreyHat');
  const sc = document.getElementById('btnSecCycle');
  if(wh) wh.addEventListener('click', () => SecurityPostureManager.whiteHatScan());
  if(bh) bh.addEventListener('click', () => SecurityPostureManager.blackHatAttack());
  if(gh) gh.addEventListener('click', () => SecurityPostureManager.greyHatBoundary());
  if(sc) sc.addEventListener('click', () => SecurityPostureManager.runFullCycle());

  log('Brain Map rendered — 23 systems · 7 groups · MSV tracking active.', 'ok');
}

/* ── Lightweight card refresh ──
   Updates status badges and security badges in-place without
   rebuilding the full DOM (avoids scroll reset and event re-bind).
══ */
function refreshBrainCards(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-brain');
  if(!panel) return;
  SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.forEach(sys => {
    const card = panel.querySelector(`.brain-card[data-sys-id="${sys.id}"]`);
    if(!card) return;
    const sb = card.querySelector('.status-badge');
    if(sb){
      sb.className = `status-badge ${sys.status}`;
      sb.textContent = sys.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + sys.status.slice(1);
    }
    const sec = card.querySelector('.security-badge');
    const sp  = SEC_POSTURES[sys.security || 'white'];
    if(sec){
      sec.className  = `security-badge ${sp.cls}`;
      sec.textContent = `${sp.icon} ${sp.label}`;
    }
  });
  updateHealthCounts();
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   BRAIN MAP SELF-IMPROVEMENT TRACKER
   Records interactions and adjusts MSV values in
   response. Pattern: most-interacted system gets
   importance + experiential boosts. No external
   calls — purely in-memory state mutation.
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const BrainMapSelfImprovement = {
  recordInteraction(id){
    const sys = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.find(s => s.id === id);
    if(!sys) return;
    sys.interactions = (sys.interactions || 0) + 1;
    // MSV mutation: more interactions → higher importance & experiential match
    sys.msv.importance   = Math.min(100, sys.msv.importance   + 2);
    sys.msv.experiential = Math.min(100, sys.msv.experiential + 1);
    // Rebuild MSV bars on the card (lightweight update)
    const panel = document.getElementById('panel-brain');
    const card  = panel && panel.querySelector(`.brain-card[data-sys-id="${id}"]`);
    if(card){
      const msvEl = card.querySelector('.brain-card-msv');
      if(msvEl) msvEl.outerHTML = buildMSVHTML(sys.msv);
    }
    // Log pattern insight after threshold
    if(sys.interactions === 3){
      log(`RSI: "${sys.name}" is a focus point (${sys.interactions} interactions) — IMP boosted to ${sys.msv.importance}%.`, 'neuro');
    }
  }
};

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECURITY POSTURE MANAGER — MOCK SIMULATIONS
   These functions update .security badges on
   system objects with mock random outcomes to
   demonstrate what real security monitoring
   would look like. NO actual exploit code.
   White Hat: audit → flag suspicious
   Black Hat: adversarial simulation → mark compromised
   Grey Hat: boundary test → mark testing
   Real integration: replace the Math.random()
   calls with actual scanner API responses.
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const SecurityPostureManager = {
  whiteHatScan(){
    log('🛡 White Hat Scan — auditing all 23 brain systems…', 'info');
    let flagged = 0;
    SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.forEach(sys => {
      sys.security = Math.random() > 0.8 ? 'grey' : 'white';
      if(sys.security === 'grey') flagged++;
    });
    log(`🛡 Scan complete — ${flagged} system(s) flagged for review, ${23 - flagged} secured.`, flagged > 0 ? 'warn' : 'ok');
    refreshBrainCards();
  },
  blackHatAttack(){
    log('⚔ Black Hat Simulation — probing defenses (mock only)…', 'warn');
    let hit = 0;
    SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.forEach(sys => {
      if(Math.random() > 0.88){
        sys.security = 'black';
        hit++;
        log(`⚔ Simulated breach: ${sys.name} (${sys.analog})`, 'error');
      }
    });
    log(`⚔ Simulation done — ${hit} simulated breach(es). Run White Hat Scan to remediate.`, hit > 0 ? 'error' : 'ok');
    refreshBrainCards();
  },
  greyHatBoundary(){
    log('◈ Grey Hat Boundary Test — exploring edge cases…', 'info');
    let edges = 0;
    SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.forEach(sys => {
      if(sys.security !== 'black' && Math.random() > 0.85){
        sys.security = 'grey';
        edges++;
      }
    });
    log(`◈ Boundary test done — ${edges} edge case(s) found.`, edges > 0 ? 'warn' : 'ok');
    refreshBrainCards();
  },
  runFullCycle(){
    log('↺ Running full three-hat security cycle…', 'neuro');
    this.whiteHatScan();
    setTimeout(() => this.blackHatAttack(),  380);
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.greyHatBoundary();
      setTimeout(() => log('↺ Full cycle complete. Run White Hat Scan to clear all findings.', 'ok'), 100);
    }, 760);
  }
};

/* ── Initialize extended fields on body registry ── */
function initBodySystemData(){
  const rnd = (a,b) => Math.floor(Math.random()*(b-a+1))+a;
  SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body.forEach(sys => {
    if(!sys.msv) sys.msv = {
      emotional:    rnd(22,78),
      correctness:  rnd(38,86),
      experiential: rnd(18,72),
      conflicting:  rnd(4,42),
      importance:   rnd(32,90)
    };
    if(!sys.security)     sys.security     = 'white';
    if(!sys.interactions) sys.interactions = 0;
  });
}

/* ── Build a single body card ──
   Reuses .brain-card base + .body-card teal overrides.
   Shows gateway chip instead of dependency chips.
══ */
function buildBodyCard(sys){
  const st    = sys.status || 'idle';
  const stLbl = st.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + st.slice(1);
  const sp    = SEC_POSTURES[sys.security || 'white'];
  const desc  = BODY_DESCRIPTIONS[sys.id] || 'No description available.';
  const gw    = BODY_GATEWAY_TYPES[sys.id] || 'internal';
  const gwInfo = GATEWAY_LABELS[gw] || GATEWAY_LABELS.internal;

  return `<div class="brain-card body-card" data-sys-id="${escapeHtml(sys.id)}" data-category="body">
    <div class="brain-card-header">
      <span class="brain-card-name">${escapeHtml(sys.name)}</span>
      <span class="status-badge ${escapeHtml(st)}">${escapeHtml(stLbl)}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="brain-card-analog">⬡ ${escapeHtml(sys.analog)}</div>
    <div class="brain-card-desc">${escapeHtml(desc)}</div>
    <div class="brain-card-divider"></div>
    ${buildMSVHTML(sys.msv)}
    <div class="brain-card-footer">
      <span class="security-badge ${sp.cls}">${sp.icon} ${escapeHtml(sp.label)}</span>
      <span class="gateway-chip ${gw}" style="margin-left:auto">${escapeHtml(gwInfo.label)}</span>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

/* ── Main body map render ──
   Builds full innerHTML of #panel-body.
   Called once on init; called again by BodySecurityManager
   after full security cycles that update .security values.
══ */
function renderBodyMap(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-body');
  if(!panel) return;

  const sysMap = {};
  SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body.forEach(s => { sysMap[s.id] = s; });

  let html = '';

  // Gateway type legend
  html += `<div class="brain-research-bar">`;
  Object.entries(GATEWAY_LABELS).forEach(([k, v]) => {
    html += `<span class="research-badge" style="color:${v.color};border-color:${v.color}55;background:${v.color}11">⬡ ${escapeHtml(v.label)}</span>`;
  });
  html += `</div>`;

  // Security toolbar (mirrors brain toolbar, operates on body systems)
  html += `<div class="brain-toolbar">
    <button class="btn" id="bodyWhiteHatBtn">🛡 White Hat Scan</button>
    <button class="btn" id="bodyBlackHatBtn">⚔ Black Hat Sim</button>
    <button class="btn" id="bodyGreyHatBtn">◈ Grey Hat Test</button>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="bodySecCycleBtn">↺ Full Cycle</button>
  </div>`;

  html += `<div class="section-heading">Body Systems
    <span style="font-weight:400;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9.5px;margin-left:8px;color:var(--text-dim);">
      49 components · ${BODY_GROUPS.length} groups
    </span>
  </div>`;

  BODY_GROUPS.forEach(group => {
    const systems = group.ids.map(id => sysMap[id]).filter(Boolean);
    if(!systems.length) return;
    html += `<div class="brain-group-header body-group-header">
      <span class="g-bar"></span>
      ${escapeHtml(group.label)}
      <span class="g-count">${systems.length}</span>
    </div>`;
    html += `<div class="brain-grid">`;
    systems.forEach(sys => { html += buildBodyCard(sys); });
    html += `</div>`;
  });

  panel.innerHTML = html;

  // ── Card click handlers ──
  panel.querySelectorAll('.body-card').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('click', () => {
      panel.querySelectorAll('.body-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
      card.classList.add('selected');
      const id = card.dataset.sysId;
      selectSystem(id, 'body');
      // Boost MSV importance on repeated interaction
      const sys = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body.find(s => s.id === id);
      if(sys && sys.msv){
        sys.msv.importance   = Math.min(100, sys.msv.importance   + 2);
        sys.msv.experiential = Math.min(100, sys.msv.experiential + 1);
        const msvEl = card.querySelector('.brain-card-msv');
        if(msvEl) msvEl.outerHTML = buildMSVHTML(sys.msv);
      }
    });
  });

  // ── Toolbar handlers ──
  const wb = document.getElementById('bodyWhiteHatBtn');
  const bb = document.getElementById('bodyBlackHatBtn');
  const gb = document.getElementById('bodyGreyHatBtn');
  const sb = document.getElementById('bodySecCycleBtn');
  if(wb) wb.addEventListener('click', () => BodySecurityManager.whiteHatScan());
  if(bb) bb.addEventListener('click', () => BodySecurityManager.blackHatAttack());
  if(gb) gb.addEventListener('click', () => BodySecurityManager.greyHatBoundary());
  if(sb) sb.addEventListener('click', () => BodySecurityManager.runFullCycle());

  log('Body Map rendered — 49 systems · 11 groups · gateway types mapped.', 'ok');
}

/* ── Lightweight body card refresh ──
   Updates status and security badges in-place without
   rebuilding the full DOM (preserves scroll position).
══ */
function refreshBodyCards(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-body');
  if(!panel) return;
  SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body.forEach(sys => {
    const card = panel.querySelector(`.body-card[data-sys-id="${sys.id}"]`);
    if(!card) return;
    const sb = card.querySelector('.status-badge');
    if(sb){
      sb.className  = `status-badge ${sys.status}`;
      sb.textContent = sys.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + sys.status.slice(1);
    }
    const sec = card.querySelector('.security-badge');
    const sp  = SEC_POSTURES[sys.security || 'white'];
    if(sec){
      sec.className  = `security-badge ${sp.cls}`;
      sec.textContent = `${sp.icon} ${sp.label}`;
    }
  });
  updateHealthCounts();
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
