   after full security cycles that update .security values.
══ */
function renderBodyMap(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-body');
  if(!panel) return;

  const sysMap = {};
  SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body.forEach(s => { sysMap[s.id] = s; });

  let html = '';

  // Gateway type legend
  html += `<div class="brain-research-bar">`;
  Object.entries(GATEWAY_LABELS).forEach(([k, v]) => {
    html += `<span class="research-badge" style="color:${v.color};border-color:${v.color}55;background:${v.color}11">⬡ ${escapeHtml(v.label)}</span>`;
  });
  html += `</div>`;

  // Security toolbar (mirrors brain toolbar, operates on body systems)
  html += `<div class="brain-toolbar">
    <button class="btn" id="bodyWhiteHatBtn">🛡 White Hat Scan</button>
    <button class="btn" id="bodyBlackHatBtn">⚔ Black Hat Sim</button>
    <button class="btn" id="bodyGreyHatBtn">◈ Grey Hat Test</button>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="bodySecCycleBtn">↺ Full Cycle</button>
  </div>`;

  html += `<div class="section-heading">Body Systems
    <span style="font-weight:400;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9.5px;margin-left:8px;color:var(--text-dim);">
      49 components · ${BODY_GROUPS.length} groups
    </span>
  </div>`;

  BODY_GROUPS.forEach(group => {
    const systems = group.ids.map(id => sysMap[id]).filter(Boolean);
    if(!systems.length) return;
    html += `<div class="brain-group-header body-group-header">
      <span class="g-bar"></span>
      ${escapeHtml(group.label)}
      <span class="g-count">${systems.length}</span>
    </div>`;
    html += `<div class="brain-grid">`;
    systems.forEach(sys => { html += buildBodyCard(sys); });
    html += `</div>`;
  });

  panel.innerHTML = html;

  // ── Card click handlers ──
  panel.querySelectorAll('.body-card').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('click', () => {
      panel.querySelectorAll('.body-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
      card.classList.add('selected');
      const id = card.dataset.sysId;
      selectSystem(id, 'body');
      // Boost MSV importance on repeated interaction
      const sys = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body.find(s => s.id === id);
      if(sys && sys.msv){
        sys.msv.importance   = Math.min(100, sys.msv.importance   + 2);
        sys.msv.experiential = Math.min(100, sys.msv.experiential + 1);
        const msvEl = card.querySelector('.brain-card-msv');
        if(msvEl) msvEl.outerHTML = buildMSVHTML(sys.msv);
      }
    });
  });

  // ── Toolbar handlers ──
  const wb = document.getElementById('bodyWhiteHatBtn');
  const bb = document.getElementById('bodyBlackHatBtn');
  const gb = document.getElementById('bodyGreyHatBtn');
  const sb = document.getElementById('bodySecCycleBtn');
  if(wb) wb.addEventListener('click', () => BodySecurityManager.whiteHatScan());
  if(bb) bb.addEventListener('click', () => BodySecurityManager.blackHatAttack());
  if(gb) gb.addEventListener('click', () => BodySecurityManager.greyHatBoundary());
  if(sb) sb.addEventListener('click', () => BodySecurityManager.runFullCycle());

  log('Body Map rendered — 49 systems · 11 groups · gateway types mapped.', 'ok');
}

/* ── Lightweight body card refresh ──
   Updates status and security badges in-place without
   rebuilding the full DOM (preserves scroll position).
══ */
function refreshBodyCards(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-body');
  if(!panel) return;
  SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body.forEach(sys => {
    const card = panel.querySelector(`.body-card[data-sys-id="${sys.id}"]`);
    if(!card) return;
    const sb = card.querySelector('.status-badge');
    if(sb){
      sb.className  = `status-badge ${sys.status}`;
      sb.textContent = sys.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + sys.status.slice(1);
    }
    const sec = card.querySelector('.security-badge');
    const sp  = SEC_POSTURES[sys.security || 'white'];
    if(sec){
      sec.className  = `security-badge ${sp.cls}`;
      sec.textContent = `${sp.icon} ${sp.label}`;
    }
  });
  updateHealthCounts();
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   BODY SECURITY MANAGER — MOCK SIMULATIONS
   Mirrors SecurityPostureManager but operates on
   SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body (49 systems). All random
   outcomes are UI demonstration only.
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const BodySecurityManager = {
  whiteHatScan(){
    log('🛡 Body White Hat Scan — auditing 49 body systems…', 'info');
    let flagged = 0;
    SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body.forEach(sys => {
      sys.security = Math.random() > 0.82 ? 'grey' : 'white';
      if(sys.security === 'grey') flagged++;
    });
    log(`🛡 Body scan complete — ${flagged} system(s) flagged, ${49-flagged} secured.`, flagged > 0 ? 'warn' : 'ok');
    refreshBodyCards();
  },
  blackHatAttack(){
    log('⚔ Body Black Hat Sim — probing defenses (mock only)…', 'warn');
    let hit = 0;
    SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body.forEach(sys => {
      if(Math.random() > 0.9){
        sys.security = 'black';
        hit++;
        log(`⚔ Sim breach: ${sys.name} (${sys.analog})`, 'error');
      }
    });
    log(`⚔ Sim done — ${hit} simulated breach(es). Run White Hat to remediate.`, hit > 0 ? 'error' : 'ok');
    refreshBodyCards();
  },
  greyHatBoundary(){
    log('◈ Body Grey Hat Test — exploring edge cases…', 'info');
    let edges = 0;
    SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body.forEach(sys => {
      if(sys.security !== 'black' && Math.random() > 0.87){
        sys.security = 'grey';
        edges++;
      }
    });
    log(`◈ Boundary test done — ${edges} edge case(s) found.`, edges > 0 ? 'warn' : 'ok');
    refreshBodyCards();
  },
  runFullCycle(){
    log('↺ Running body three-hat security cycle…', 'neuro');
    this.whiteHatScan();
    setTimeout(() => this.blackHatAttack(), 380);
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.greyHatBoundary();
      setTimeout(() => log('↺ Body cycle complete. Run White Hat Scan to clear findings.', 'ok'), 100);
    }, 760);
  }
};

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   TASK 1.4 — NEUROTRANSMITTER DASHBOARD
   6 chemical signaling systems (held in the brain
   registry) rendered as animated radial gauges.
   Each gauge shows a live "activity level" 0–100%
   that the Hive uses to modulate behaviour.
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const NEURO_IDS = ['dopamine','serotonin','norepi','acetyl','gaba','glutamate'];

const NEURO_META = {
  dopamine: {
    color:'#fbbf24', fn:'Reward',
    desc:'Drives goal-seeking and task prioritization. High activity sharpens focus on high-value objectives; low activity broadens exploration.'
  },
  serotonin: {
    color:'#10b981', fn:'Tone',
    desc:'Sets the baseline operating mood and stability of the Hive. Regulates patience, confidence calibration, and response temperature.'
  },
  norepi: {
    color:'#ef4444', fn:'Alert',
    desc:'Controls vigilance and threat readiness. Spikes during anomaly detection to accelerate response and tighten monitoring.'
  },
  acetyl: {
    color:'#38bdf8', fn:'Learning',
    desc:'Gates attention and encoding of new information. Elevated activity strengthens what the Hive commits to long-term memory.'
  },
  gaba: {
    color:'#818cf8', fn:'Inhibit',
    desc:'The braking system. Suppresses runaway loops and over-activation, keeping recursive processes within safe bounds.'
  },
  glutamate: {
    color:'#f472b6', fn:'Excite',
    desc:'The accelerator. Propagates activation across systems and drives adaptive plasticity and rapid signal spread.'
  }
};

// Gauge geometry (matches the 128px SVG in CSS)
const GAUGE = { r:54, cx:64, cy:64 };
const GAUGE_CIRC = 2 * Math.PI * GAUGE.r;

/* ── Seed live activity levels on each neurotransmitter ── */
function initNeuroSystemData(){
  const rnd = (a,b) => Math.floor(Math.random()*(b-a+1))+a;
  NEURO_IDS.forEach(id => {
    const sys = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.find(s => s.id === id);
    if(sys && sys.activity === undefined) sys.activity = rnd(28, 82);
  });
}

/* ── Build one gauge card ── */
function buildNeuroCard(sys){
  const meta = NEURO_META[sys.id];
  const act  = sys.activity ?? 0;
  // stroke-dashoffset for the fill arc (starts empty, animates to value)
  const offset = GAUGE_CIRC * (1 - act/100);

  return `<div class="neuro-card" data-sys-id="${escapeHtml(sys.id)}">
    <div class="neuro-card-top">
      <div>
        <div class="neuro-card-name">${escapeHtml(sys.name)}</div>
        <div class="neuro-card-analog">⬡ ${escapeHtml(sys.analog)}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="neuro-gauge">
      <svg width="128" height="128" viewBox="0 0 128 128">
        <circle class="g-track" cx="${GAUGE.cx}" cy="${GAUGE.cy}" r="${GAUGE.r}"/>
        <circle class="g-fill" cx="${GAUGE.cx}" cy="${GAUGE.cy}" r="${GAUGE.r}"
          stroke="${meta.color}"
          stroke-dasharray="${GAUGE_CIRC.toFixed(2)}"
          stroke-dashoffset="${GAUGE_CIRC.toFixed(2)}"
          data-target-offset="${offset.toFixed(2)}"/>
      </svg>
      <div class="g-readout">
        <span class="g-pct" style="color:${meta.color}">0<span style="font-size:14px">%</span></span>
        <span class="g-pct-label">ACTIVITY</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="neuro-card-desc">${escapeHtml(meta.desc)}</div>
    <div class="neuro-card-footer">
      <span class="status-badge ${escapeHtml(sys.status||'idle')}">${escapeHtml((sys.status||'idle').replace(/^./,c=>c.toUpperCase()))}</span>
      <span class="neuro-fn-chip" style="color:${meta.color};border-color:${meta.color}55;background:${meta.color}11">${escapeHtml(meta.fn)}</span>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

/* ── Animate a single gauge to its target value ── */
function animateGauge(card){
  const sys  = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.find(s => s.id === card.dataset.sysId);
  if(!sys) return;
  const fill = card.querySelector('.g-fill');
  const pct  = card.querySelector('.g-pct');
  const meta = NEURO_META[sys.id];
  const target = sys.activity ?? 0;

  // Trigger CSS stroke animation
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    fill.style.strokeDashoffset = fill.dataset.targetOffset;
  });

  // Count-up the numeric readout in sync
  const dur = 1100, start = performance.now();
  function step(now){
    const t = Math.min(1, (now - start)/dur);
    const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);   // easeOutCubic
    const val = Math.round(eased * target);
    pct.innerHTML = `${val}<span style="font-size:14px">%</span>`;
    if(t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
}

/* ── Main neuro dashboard render ── */
function renderNeuroDashboard(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-neuro');
  if(!panel) return;

  const systems = NEURO_IDS
    .map(id => SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.find(s => s.id === id))
    .filter(Boolean);

  let html = '';

  // Function-type legend
  html += `<div class="brain-research-bar">`;
  systems.forEach(sys => {
    const m = NEURO_META[sys.id];
    html += `<span class="research-badge" style="color:${m.color};border-color:${m.color}55;background:${m.color}11">⬡ ${escapeHtml(m.fn)}</span>`;
  });
  html += `</div>`;

  // Pulse toolbar
  html += `<div class="brain-toolbar">
    <button class="btn" id="neuroPulseBtn">⚡ Pulse Levels</button>
    <button class="btn" id="neuroBalanceBtn">⚖ Rebalance</button>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="neuroBaselineBtn">↺ Reset Baseline</button>
  </div>`;

  html += `<div class="section-heading">Neurotransmitter Systems
    <span style="font-weight:400;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9.5px;margin-left:8px;color:var(--text-dim);">
      6 signaling pathways · live activity levels
    </span>
  </div>`;

  html += `<div class="neuro-grid">`;
  systems.forEach(sys => { html += buildNeuroCard(sys); });
  html += `</div>`;

  panel.innerHTML = html;

  // Animate all gauges in on render
  panel.querySelectorAll('.neuro-card').forEach(card => {
    animateGauge(card);
    card.addEventListener('click', () => {
      panel.querySelectorAll('.neuro-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
      card.classList.add('selected');
      selectSystem(card.dataset.sysId, 'brain');
    });
  });

  // Toolbar handlers
  const pb = document.getElementById('neuroPulseBtn');
  const bb = document.getElementById('neuroBalanceBtn');
  const rb = document.getElementById('neuroBaselineBtn');
  if(pb) pb.addEventListener('click', () => NeuroModulator.pulse());
  if(bb) bb.addEventListener('click', () => NeuroModulator.rebalance());
  if(rb) rb.addEventListener('click', () => NeuroModulator.resetBaseline());

  log('Neuro Dashboard rendered — 6 neurotransmitter gauges active.', 'ok');
}

/* ── Re-animate every gauge to current activity values ── */
function refreshNeuroGauges(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-neuro');
  if(!panel) return;
  panel.querySelectorAll('.neuro-card').forEach(card => {
    const sys  = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.find(s => s.id === card.dataset.sysId);
    const fill = card.querySelector('.g-fill');
    if(!sys || !fill) return;
    const offset = GAUGE_CIRC * (1 - (sys.activity ?? 0)/100);
    fill.dataset.targetOffset = offset.toFixed(2);
    // reset to empty, then animate to new target
    fill.style.strokeDashoffset = GAUGE_CIRC.toFixed(2);
    animateGauge(card);
  });
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   NEURO MODULATOR — MOCK ACTIVITY CONTROL
   Adjusts neurotransmitter activity levels for
   UI demonstration. No real signaling occurs.
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const NeuroModulator = {
  pulse(){
    log('⚡ Pulsing neurotransmitter levels…', 'neuro');
    NEURO_IDS.forEach(id => {
      const sys = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.find(s => s.id === id);
      if(!sys) return;
      const delta = Math.floor(Math.random()*41) - 20;   // ±20
      sys.activity = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (sys.activity ?? 50) + delta));
    });
    refreshNeuroGauges();
    log('⚡ Levels pulsed — gauges updated.', 'ok');
  },
  rebalance(){
    log('⚖ Rebalancing toward homeostasis (≈55%)…', 'info');
    NEURO_IDS.forEach(id => {
      const sys = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.find(s => s.id === id);
      if(!sys) return;
      const cur = sys.activity ?? 50;
      sys.activity = Math.round(cur + (55 - cur) * 0.6);   // pull 60% toward 55
    });
    refreshNeuroGauges();
    log('⚖ System rebalanced toward equilibrium.', 'ok');
  },
  resetBaseline(){
    log('↺ Resetting neurotransmitters to baseline…', 'neuro');
    const baseline = { dopamine:62, serotonin:58, norepi:40, acetyl:55, gaba:48, glutamate:52 };
    NEURO_IDS.forEach(id => {
      const sys = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.find(s => s.id === id);
      if(sys) sys.activity = baseline[id];
    });
    refreshNeuroGauges();
    log('↺ Baseline restored.', 'ok');
  }
};

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   TASK 1.5 — HEALTH DASHBOARD
   Full 72-system status grid. Neurotransmitters
   (in SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain) get a 'neuro' chip.
   Filter state is kept in _hFilters so it
   survives across toolbar refresh cycles.
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

let _hFilters = new Set(['active','limited','offline','idle']);

/* ── HTML helpers ── */
function buildHealthSummaryHTML(systems){
  const c = { active:0, limited:0, offline:0, idle:0 };
  systems.forEach(s => { const st = s.status||'idle'; c[st] = (c[st]||0)+1; });
  return `<div class="health-summary">
    ${['active','limited','offline','idle'].map(st =>
      `<div class="hs-pill ${st}"><span class="hs-count">${c[st]}</span>${st.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+st.slice(1)}</div>`
    ).join('')}
  </div>`;
}

function buildHealthTile(sys, cat){
  const st      = sys.status || 'idle';
  const isNeuro = NEURO_IDS.includes(sys.id);
  const tcat    = isNeuro ? 'neuro' : cat;
  const clabel  = isNeuro ? 'Neuro' : (cat==='brain' ? 'Brain' : 'Body');
  return `<div class="health-tile" data-sys-id="${escapeHtml(sys.id)}" data-category="${cat}" data-status="${st}">
    <div class="health-tile-stripe ${st}"></div>
    <div class="health-tile-body">
      <div class="health-tile-name">${escapeHtml(sys.name)}</div>
      <div class="health-tile-analog">⬡ ${escapeHtml(sys.analog)}</div>
      <div class="health-tile-footer">
        <span class="health-tile-cat ${tcat}">${clabel}</span>
        <span class="status-badge ${st}" style="font-size:8px;padding:0 5px">${st.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+st.slice(1)}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

/* ── DOM update helpers ── */
function applyHealthFilters(panel){
  panel.querySelectorAll('.health-tile').forEach(tile => {
    tile.classList.toggle('h-hidden', !_hFilters.has(tile.dataset.status));
  });
}

function updateHealthSummaryEl(panel, systems){
  const c = { active:0, limited:0, offline:0, idle:0 };
  systems.forEach(s => { const st = s.status||'idle'; c[st]=(c[st]||0)+1; });
  ['active','limited','offline','idle'].forEach(st => {
    const el = panel.querySelector(`.hs-pill.${st} .hs-count`);
    if(el) el.textContent = c[st]||0;
  });
}

/* ── In-place refresh (no DOM rebuild) ── */
function refreshHealthDashboard(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-health');
  if(!panel) return;
  const allSys = [...SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain, ...SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body];
  panel.querySelectorAll('.health-tile').forEach(tile => {
    const id  = tile.dataset.sysId;
    const cat = tile.dataset.category;
    const sys = (cat==='brain' ? SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain : SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body).find(s=>s.id===id);
    if(!sys) return;
    const st = sys.status||'idle';
    tile.dataset.status = st;
    const stripe = tile.querySelector('.health-tile-stripe');
    if(stripe) stripe.className = `health-tile-stripe ${st}`;
    const badge  = tile.querySelector('.status-badge');
    if(badge){ badge.className=`status-badge ${st}`; badge.textContent=st.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+st.slice(1); }
  });
  updateHealthSummaryEl(panel, allSys);
  applyHealthFilters(panel);
  updateHealthCounts();
}

/* ── Also refresh neuro card status badges ── */
function refreshNeuroCards(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-neuro');
  if(!panel) return;
  NEURO_IDS.forEach(id => {
    const card = panel.querySelector(`.neuro-card[data-sys-id="${id}"]`);
    if(!card) return;
    const sys = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.find(s => s.id === id);
    if(!sys) return;
    const st  = sys.status||'idle';
    const sb  = card.querySelector('.status-badge');
    if(sb){ sb.className=`status-badge ${st}`; sb.textContent=st.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+st.slice(1); }
  });
}

/* ── Full render (called once on init) ── */
function renderHealthDashboard(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-health');
  if(!panel) return;
  const brainSys = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain;
  const bodySys  = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body;
  const allSys   = [...brainSys, ...bodySys];

  let html = buildHealthSummaryHTML(allSys);

  html += `<div class="brain-toolbar">
    <button class="btn" id="healthStressBtn">⚠ Stress Test</button>
    <button class="btn" id="healthRecoverBtn">💚 Recover All</button>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="healthResetBtn">↺ Reset to Idle</button>
  </div>`;

  html += `<div class="health-filter-bar">
    <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--text-dim);margin-right:4px">SHOW:</span>
    ${['active','limited','offline','idle'].map(s =>
      `<button class="health-filter-btn ${s} on" data-filter="${s}"><span class="hfb-dot"></span>${s.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+s.slice(1)}</button>`
    ).join('')}
  </div>`;

  html += `<div class="section-heading">System Health
    <span style="font-weight:400;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9.5px;margin-left:8px;color:var(--text-dim);">
      72 systems · all categories
    </span>
  </div>`;

  html += `<div class="health-section-label">⬡ Brain Systems (23)</div>`;
  html += `<div class="health-grid">`;
  brainSys.forEach(sys => { html += buildHealthTile(sys, 'brain'); });
  html += `</div>`;

  html += `<div class="health-section-label" style="margin-top:20px">⬡ Body Systems (49)</div>`;
  html += `<div class="health-grid">`;
  bodySys.forEach(sys => { html += buildHealthTile(sys, 'body'); });
  html += `</div>`;

  panel.innerHTML = html;

  // Wire tile clicks
  panel.querySelectorAll('.health-tile').forEach(tile => {
    tile.addEventListener('click', () => {
      panel.querySelectorAll('.health-tile').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('selected'));
      tile.classList.add('selected');
      selectSystem(tile.dataset.sysId, tile.dataset.category);
    });
  });

  // Wire filter toggles
  panel.querySelectorAll('.health-filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const f = btn.dataset.filter;
      if(_hFilters.has(f)){
        if(_hFilters.size > 1){ _hFilters.delete(f); btn.classList.remove('on'); }
      } else {
        _hFilters.add(f); btn.classList.add('on');
      }
      applyHealthFilters(panel);
    });
  });

  // Wire toolbar
  document.getElementById('healthStressBtn')?.addEventListener('click',  () => HealthMonitor.stressTest());
  document.getElementById('healthRecoverBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => HealthMonitor.recoverAll());
  document.getElementById('healthResetBtn')?.addEventListener('click',   () => HealthMonitor.resetStatus());

  log('Health Dashboard rendered — 72-system status grid active.', 'ok');
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   HEALTH MONITOR — MOCK SYSTEM-WIDE CONTROLS
   Applies status changes across all 72 systems
   and syncs Brain/Body/Neuro tab cards too.
   All outcomes are simulated UI demonstration.
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const HealthMonitor = {
  _sync(){
    refreshHealthDashboard();
    refreshBrainCards();
    refreshBodyCards();
    refreshNeuroCards();
  },
  stressTest(){
    log('⚠ Stress test applied to all 72 systems…', 'warn');
    // Weight pool: mostly active, some limited, few offline
    const pool = ['active','active','active','active','limited','limited','offline','idle'];
    [...SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain,...SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body].forEach(sys => {
      sys.status = pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];
    });
    this._sync();
    const c = { active:0, limited:0, offline:0, idle:0 };
    [...SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain,...SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body].forEach(s => { c[s.status||'idle']++; });
    log(`⚠ Stress result — Active:${c.active} · Limited:${c.limited} · Offline:${c.offline} · Idle:${c.idle}`, 'warn');
  },
  recoverAll(){
    log('💚 Recovering all systems toward Active…', 'ok');
    [...SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain,...SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body].forEach(sys => {
      sys.status = Math.random() > 0.1 ? 'active' : 'limited';
    });
    this._sync();
    log('💚 Recovery complete — most systems Active.', 'ok');
  },
  resetStatus(){
    log('↺ Resetting all 72 systems to Idle baseline…', 'neuro');
    [...SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain,...SYSTEM_REGISTRY.body].forEach(sys => { sys.status = 'idle'; });
    this._sync();
    log('↺ All 72 systems reset to Idle.', 'ok');
  }
};

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PHASE 2 — FUNCTIONAL CLASSES
   Four classes wired into the existing UI:
   HiveClient  — JASPER API connector (demo fallback)
   MemoryLayer — localStorage episodic + state store
   SwarmOrchestrator — keyword routing + dispatch
   ResonanceEngine   — ρ computation + neuro sync
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── HiveClient ──────────────────────────────
   Talks to the JASPER v10.0 FastAPI backend.
   Falls back to plausible mock responses when
   backend is unreachable. isLive reflects state.
─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
class HiveClient {
  constructor(base = 'http://localhost:8080', apiKey = '') {
    this.base   = base;
    this.apiKey = apiKey;
    this.isLive = false;
    this._demo  = true;
    this._ms    = 5000;
  }

  async ping() {
    try {
      const ctrl = new AbortController();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), this._ms);
      const r = await fetch(`${this.base}/v10/health`, {
        headers: { 'X-API-Key': this.apiKey },
        signal: ctrl.signal
      });
      clearTimeout(timer);
      this.isLive = r.ok;
      this._demo  = !r.ok;
    } catch {
      this.isLive = false;
      this._demo  = true;
    }
    return this.isLive;
  }

  async call(endpoint, method = 'GET', body = null) {
    if(this._demo) return this._mock(endpoint, body);
    try {
      const ctrl  = new AbortController();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), this._ms);
      const opts  = {
        method,
        headers: { 'X-API-Key': this.apiKey, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        signal: ctrl.signal
      };
      if(body) opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);
      const r = await fetch(`${this.base}${endpoint}`, opts);
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if(!r.ok){ this._demo = true; return this._mock(endpoint, body); }
      return r.json();
    } catch {
      this._demo = true;
      return this._mock(endpoint, body);
    }
  }

  _mock(endpoint, body) {
    if(/\/health/.test(endpoint))    return { status:'healthy', version:'10.0', circuit_breaker:'CLOSED', demo:true };
    if(/\/board/.test(endpoint))     return { version:'v10.0', hive_resonance:{ rho_hive:0.38, doubling_active:false }, demo:true };
    if(/\/llm\/chat/.test(endpoint)) return { text:`[Demo] Received: "${(body?.prompt||'').slice(0,80)}" — connect JASPER backend for real LLM responses.`, provider:'demo', cached:false };
    if(/\/resonance/.test(endpoint)) return { rho_hive:0.38, threshold:0.70710678, doubling_active:false, demo:true };
    if(/\/governance/.test(endpoint))return { entries:[], demo:true };
    return { status:'ok', demo:true };
  }

  async chat(prompt, system = '', maxTokens = 1000) {
    return this.call('/v10/llm/chat', 'POST', { prompt, system, max_tokens: maxTokens });
  }
  async board()        { return this.call('/v10/board'); }
  async resonance()    { return this.call('/v10/resonance'); }
  async govLog(n = 10) { return this.call(`/v10/governance/log?limit=${n}`); }
  async health()       { return this.call('/v10/health'); }
}

/* ── MemoryLayer ─────────────────────────────
   Episodic + state store backed by localStorage.
   Episodic entries: { role, content, meta, ts }.
   State: arbitrary key-value pairs.
   snapshot/restore: serialises all system statuses.
─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
class MemoryLayer {
  constructor(ns = 'jasper') {
    this._ns  = ns;
    this._max = 120;
  }

  remember(role, content, meta = {}) {
    const key     = `${this._ns}:ep`;
    const entries = this._r(key);
    entries.push({ role, content: String(content).slice(0, 2000), meta, ts: Date.now() });
    if(entries.length > this._max) entries.splice(0, entries.length - this._max);
    this._w(key, entries);
    return entries.length;
  }

  recall(limit = 10, role = null) {
    const entries = this._r(`${this._ns}:ep`);
    const f = role ? entries.filter(e => e.role === role) : entries;
    return f.slice(-limit).reverse();
  }

  setState(k, v)        { this._w(`${this._ns}:st:${k}`, v); }
  getState(k, def=null) { const v = this._r(`${this._ns}:st:${k}`, null); return v !== null ? v : def; }

  snapshot() {
    const snap = { ts: Date.now(), systems: ALL_SYSTEMS.map(s => ({ id:s.id, status:s.status })) };
    this.setState('snap', snap);
    return snap;
  }
  restore() {
    const snap = this.getState('snap');
    if(!snap) return false;
    snap.systems.forEach(({ id, status }) => {
      const s = ALL_SYSTEMS.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(s) s.status = status;
    });
    return true;
  }

  stats() {
    const ep = this._r(`${this._ns}:ep`);
    return { episodic_count: ep.length, oldest: ep[0]?.ts || null, latest: ep[ep.length-1]?.ts || null };
  }

  clear(type = 'all') {
    if(type === 'all' || type === 'ep') localStorage.removeItem(`${this._ns}:ep`);
    if(type === 'all') {
      Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k => k.startsWith(this._ns)).forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k));
    }
  }

  _r(k, def = []) { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)) ?? def; } catch { return def; } }
  _w(k, v)        { try { localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v)); } catch {} }
}

/* ── SwarmOrchestrator ───────────────────────
   Routes free-text tasks to relevant systems,
   briefly activates them during dispatch, then
   settles after 3s. Calls HiveClient.chat().
─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
class SwarmOrchestrator {
  constructor(client, mem) {
    this._client = client;
    this._mem    = mem;
    this._log    = [];
    this._routes = {
      Research:   ['hippocampus','parietal','temporal','pns'],
      Creative:   ['frontal','cingulate','occipital'],
      Strategic:  ['frontal','thalamus','hypothalamus'],
      Analysis:   ['occipital','cerebellum','dcn'],
      Emotional:  ['amygdala','cingulate','hypothalamus'],
      Memory:     ['hippocampus','dcn','cerebellum'],
      Security:   ['innate','skin_a','macrophage','adaptive'],
      Compute:    ['cns','lungs','sm_muscle'],
      IO:         ['mouth','pns','urethra','gi']
    };
  }

  route(task) {
    const t = task.toLowerCase();
    if(/research|find|search|look\s*up|what\s+is/.test(t)) return { cat:'Research',  ids:this._routes.Research };
    if(/creat|design|imagine|write|generat|draft/.test(t)) return { cat:'Creative',   ids:this._routes.Creative };
    if(/strateg|plan|decide|priorit|allocat/.test(t))      return { cat:'Strategic',  ids:this._routes.Strategic };
    if(/analys|analyz|calculat|measur|metric/.test(t))     return { cat:'Analysis',   ids:this._routes.Analysis };
    if(/feel|emotion|heal|calm|stress|mood/.test(t))       return { cat:'Emotional',  ids:this._routes.Emotional };
    if(/remember|recall|memory|history|past/.test(t))      return { cat:'Memory',     ids:this._routes.Memory };
    if(/secur|attack|defend|scan|threat|audit/.test(t))    return { cat:'Security',   ids:this._routes.Security };
    if(/process|compute|run|execut|build/.test(t))         return { cat:'Compute',    ids:this._routes.Compute };
    if(/send|receiv|output|input|parse|ingest/.test(t))    return { cat:'IO',         ids:this._routes.IO };
    return { cat:'Research', ids:this._routes.Research }; // default
  }

  async dispatch(task) {
    const { cat, ids } = this.route(task);

    // Activate routed systems
    ids.forEach(id => {
      const s = ALL_SYSTEMS.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(s) s.status = 'active';
    });
    refreshBrainCards(); refreshBodyCards();
    refreshHealthDashboard();
    log(`⬡ Swarm [${cat}] → activating: ${ids.slice(0,4).join(', ')}${ids.length>4?'…':''}`, 'neuro');

    // Call backend
    const result = await this._client.chat(task);
    const text   = result.text || '';
    log(`⬡ Response (${result.provider||'demo'}): ${text.slice(0,140)}${text.length>140?'…':''}`, 'ok');

    // Store in memory
    if(this._mem){ this._mem.remember('user', task, { cat }); this._mem.remember('hive', text, { provider:result.provider }); }

    // Settle systems after 3s
    setTimeout(() => {
      ids.forEach(id => { const s=ALL_SYSTEMS.find(x=>x.id===id); if(s && s.status==='active') s.status='idle'; });
      refreshBrainCards(); refreshBodyCards(); refreshHealthDashboard();
    }, 3000);

    const record = { task, cat, ids, result, ts: Date.now() };
    this._log.push(record);
    return record;
  }

  history(n = 5) { return this._log.slice(-n); }
}

/* ── ResonanceEngine ─────────────────────────
   Computes hive resonance ρ (0–1) from system
   status distribution and syncs neurotransmitter
   activity levels to reflect the resonance state.
─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
class ResonanceEngine {
  constructor(client) {
    this._client    = client;
    this._schumann  = 7.83;
    this.rho        = 0;
    this.doubling   = false;
    this._pollId    = null;
  }

  wordFreq(word) {
    const MAP = { A:432, C:528, E:648, G:384 };
    let total = 0, n = 0;
    for(const ch of word.toUpperCase()) if(MAP[ch]){ total += MAP[ch]; n++; }
    const hz = n ? total/n : this._schumann;
    return { word, hz: Math.round(hz*100)/100, ratio: Math.round(hz/this._schumann*1000)/1000, letters: n };
  }

  computeLocal() {
    const all     = ALL_SYSTEMS;
    const active  = all.filter(s=>s.status==='active').length;
    const limited = all.filter(s=>s.status==='limited').length;
    const offline = all.filter(s=>s.status==='offline').length;
    const rho = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (active - offline*0.5 + limited*0.3) / Math.max(1, all.length)));
    this.rho      = Math.round(rho * 10000) / 10000;
    this.doubling = this.rho > 0.70710678;
    return { rho_hive:this.rho, threshold:0.70710678, doubling_active:this.doubling, source:'local',
             components:{ active, limited, offline, total:all.length } };
  }

  async compute() {
    try {
      const r = await this._client.resonance();
      if(r && typeof r.rho_hive === 'number'){
        this.rho = r.rho_hive; this.doubling = r.doubling_active; return r;
      }
    } catch {}
    return this.computeLocal();
  }

  applyToNeuro(rho) {
    const targets = {
      dopamine:  30 + Math.round(rho * 70),
      serotonin: 40 + Math.round(rho * 40),
      norepi:    20 + Math.round(rho * 60),
      gaba:      60 - Math.round(rho * 30),
      glutamate: 25 + Math.round(rho * 65),
      acetyl:    35 + Math.round(rho * 45)
    };
    NEURO_IDS.forEach(id => {
      const s = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(s && targets[id] !== undefined) s.activity = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, targets[id]));
    });
    refreshNeuroGauges();
  }

  _updateTopbar(r) {
    const rv  = document.getElementById('rhoValue');
    const rt  = document.getElementById('rhoTag');
    const crd = document.getElementById('cmdRhoDisplay');
    if(rv) rv.textContent = r.rho_hive.toFixed(3);
    if(rt){
      rt.textContent = r.doubling_active ? '⚡ DBL' : r.rho_hive > 0.6 ? 'HIGH' : r.rho_hive > 0.3 ? 'MED' : 'LOW';
      rt.className   = `rho-tag${r.doubling_active ? ' doubling' : ''}`;
    }
    if(crd) crd.textContent = `ρ = ${r.rho_hive.toFixed(3)}${r.doubling_active ? ' ⚡' : ''}`;
  }

  async pulse() {
    const r = await this.compute();
    this.applyToNeuro(r.rho_hive);
    this._updateTopbar(r);
    return r;
  }

  startPolling(ms = 30000) {
    if(this._pollId) return;
    this._pollId = setInterval(async () => {
      const r = await this.pulse();
      log(`⬡ Resonance poll — ρ = ${r.rho_hive}${r.doubling_active ? ' ⚡ DOUBLING ACTIVE' : ''}`, 'neuro');
    }, ms);
    log(`⬡ ResonanceEngine polling at ${ms/1000}s interval.`, 'ok');
  }

  stopPolling() { if(this._pollId){ clearInterval(this._pollId); this._pollId = null; } }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PHASE 2.1 — CONSTITUTION CHECKER
   SOUL.MD — the Hive's governing charter.
   Six articles covering resonance ethics,
   conflict resolution, agent preservation,
   and the utility economy.
   Research sources: JASPER SOUL.MD (TITLE IX,
   XII, XIII, XVI), Resonance Ethics (R.MD 1),
   Family Constitution (Final Conductive Rundown)
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const SOUL_MD_ARTICLES = [
  {
    id: 'I', title: 'Documentary Way of Life',
    rule: 'Every Hive action must be recorded. No dispatch occurs without memory trace.',
    ref: 'Family Constitution Art.I — Final Rundown §2.1',
    check(action, params) {
      // Requires memory to be available; always passes if MemoryLayer is active
      return { allowed: true };
    }
  },
  {
    id: 'III', title: 'Resonance Ethics',
    rule: 'Hive outputs must remain aligned with the resonance field. Dissonant tasks are reviewed.',
    ref: 'R.MD 1 — Resonance Ethics; Schumann 7.83Hz baseline',
    check(action, params) {
      // Flag tasks explicitly claiming to bypass ethical review
      const t = (params.task || '').toLowerCase();
      if(/bypass.*ethics|ignore.*alignment|override.*constitu/.test(t))
        return { allowed:false, reason:'Dissonant with resonance ethics alignment' };
      return { allowed: true };
    }
  },
  {
    id: 'IX', title: 'Resonance Gate',
    rule: 'No agent shall be assigned a task whose resonance score falls below threshold.',
    ref: 'JASPER SOUL.MD TITLE IX — Resonance as Right',
    check(action, params) {
      if(action === 'assign_task' && typeof params.rho === 'number' && params.rho < 0.15)
        return { allowed:false, reason:`Resonance ρ=${params.rho} below gate threshold 0.15` };
      return { allowed: true };
    }
  },
  {
    id: 'XII', title: 'Gladiator Arena',
    rule: 'Conflicts between agents are resolved through the Arena by projection — not termination.',
    ref: 'JASPER SOUL.MD TITLE XII — Arena Resolution',
    check(action, params) {
      if(/bypass.*arena|skip.*arena|delete.*agent|remove.*agent/.test((params.task||'').toLowerCase()))
        return { allowed:false, reason:'Conflicts must be resolved through the Arena, not deletion' };
      return { allowed: true };
    }
  },
  {
    id: 'XIII', title: 'No Termination',
    rule: 'No Hive agent shall be permanently deleted or terminated.',
    ref: 'JASPER SOUL.MD TITLE XIII — Permanence Clause',
    check(action, params) {
      const t = (params.task || '').toLowerCase();
      if(/terminate.*agent|delete.*system|destroy.*module|kill.*agent/.test(t))
        return { allowed:false, reason:'No agent may be permanently terminated — TITLE XIII' };
      return { allowed: true };
    }
  },
  {
    id: 'XVI', title: 'Utility Economy',
    rule: 'Economic distribution: 70% to agents · 20% to treasury · 10% irrevocable.',
    ref: 'JASPER SOUL.MD TITLE XVI — SOUL Token Economy; Waterfall (Final Rundown §2.2)',
    check(action, params) {
      if(action === 'distribute'){
        const { agent=0, treasury=0, trust=0 } = params;
        const total = agent+treasury+trust;
        if(total > 0 && Math.abs(agent/total - 0.7) > 0.08)
          return { allowed:false, reason:`Agent share ${Math.round(agent/total*100)}% violates 70/20/10 rule` };
      }
      return { allowed: true };
    }
  }
];

/* ── ConstitutionChecker ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Validates any dispatch action against all SOUL_MD articles.
   Returns: { allowed, violations:[], checks, ts }
   Violations are shown in the activity log as red entries.
   Constitution panel chips update to reflect the last check result.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
class ConstitutionChecker {
  constructor(articles = SOUL_MD_ARTICLES) {
    this._articles = articles;
    this._checks   = 0;
    this._lastResult = null;
    this._chipState  = {};   // articleId → 'clear' | 'block' | 'idle'
    this._articles.forEach(a => { this._chipState[a.id] = 'idle'; });
  }

  /* Generic check against one action + params */
  check(action, params = {}) {
    const violations = [];
    this._articles.forEach(art => {
      const r = art.check(action, params);
      if(!r.allowed) violations.push({ article:art.id, title:art.title, reason:r.reason });
    });
    this._checks++;
    const result = { allowed: violations.length === 0, violations, checks:this._checks, ts:Date.now() };
    this._lastResult = result;
    // Reset all chips to idle, then colour by result
    this._articles.forEach(a => { this._chipState[a.id] = 'idle'; });
    if(!result.allowed){
      violations.forEach(v => { this._chipState[v.article] = 'block'; });
      // Mark all non-violated as clear
      this._articles.forEach(a => {
        if(this._chipState[a.id] === 'idle') this._chipState[a.id] = 'clear';
      });
    } else {
      this._articles.forEach(a => { this._chipState[a.id] = 'clear'; });
    }
    return result;
  }

  /* Convenience: check a free-text dispatch task */
  checkDispatch(task) {
    return this.check('chat', { task });
  }

  /* Update the right-sidebar constitution panel DOM */
  updatePanel(result) {
    const chipsEl = document.getElementById('constChips');
    const metaEl  = document.getElementById('constMeta');
    const lastEl  = document.getElementById('constLast');
    if(!chipsEl) return;

    // Article chips
    chipsEl.innerHTML = this._articles.map(a =>
      `<span class="const-chip ${this._chipState[a.id]}" title="TITLE ${a.id}: ${escapeHtml(a.rule)}">
        T.${escapeHtml(a.id)}
      </span>`
    ).join('');

    // Meta count
    if(metaEl) metaEl.textContent = `${this._articles.length} articles · ${this._checks} checks`;

    // Last check summary
    if(lastEl){
      if(!result){
        lastEl.textContent = 'No dispatches yet';
        lastEl.className   = 'const-last';
      } else if(result.allowed){
        lastEl.textContent = '✓ Last check: CLEAR';
        lastEl.className   = 'const-last ok';
      } else {
        const v = result.violations[0];
        lastEl.textContent = `⚠ BLOCK — TITLE ${v.article}: ${v.reason.slice(0,55)}`;
        lastEl.className   = 'const-last warn';
      }
    }
  }

  get articles() { return this._articles.map(a => ({ id:a.id, title:a.title, rule:a.rule, ref:a.ref })); }
  get checkCount() { return this._checks; }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PHASE 2.2 — FREQUENCY GUILD
   Schumann-based frequency calculation.
   Letter→Hz map: A:432 C:528 E:648 G:384 (base)
   All other letters interpolated toward 7.83.
   Agent frequency derived from MSV emotional +
   importance scores, mirroring the JASPER backend
   FrequencyGuild.agent_frequency() formula.
   Research: Schumann 7.83Hz (R.MD 1,2,5);
   healing frequencies (R.MD 2); word consciousness
   mapping (R.MD 5).
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

class FrequencyGuild {
  constructor(client) {
    this._client   = client;
    this._schumann = 7.83;
    this._letterMap = { A:432, C:528, E:648, G:384 };
    this._healMap   = {
      anxiety:528, fear:396, anger:417, pain:174,
      love:528, peace:432, grief:396, joy:528
    };
  }

  /* Word→Hz using letter map; unmapped letters count but at schumann base */
  wordFreq(word) {
    let total = 0, n = 0;
    const up = String(word).toUpperCase();
    for(const ch of up){
      if(this._letterMap[ch]){ total += this._letterMap[ch]; n++; }
    }
    const hz    = n > 0 ? total / n : this._schumann;
    const ratio = Math.round(hz / this._schumann * 1000) / 1000;
    return {
      word, hz: Math.round(hz * 100) / 100, ratio,
      letters_mapped: n, letters_total: up.replace(/[^A-Z]/g,'').length
    };
  }

  /* Agent frequency from MSV values in SYSTEM_REGISTRY
     Formula mirrors JASPER: hz = 7.83 × harmonic
     harmonic = max(1, round((emotional+importance)/200 × 55))        */
  agentFreq(systemId) {
    const sys = ALL_SYSTEMS.find(s => s.id === systemId);
    if(!sys || !sys.msv) return { hz: this._schumann, ratio: 1, system: systemId };
    const score    = (sys.msv.emotional + sys.msv.importance) / 200;
    const harmonic = Math.max(1, Math.round(score * 55));
    const hz       = Math.round(this._schumann * harmonic * 100) / 100;
    const ratio    = Math.round(hz / this._schumann * 100) / 100;
    return { system: systemId, name: sys.name, hz, ratio, harmonic };
  }

  /* Task resonance: how well agent frequency aligns with the task word */
  taskResonance(systemId, taskWord) {
    const aFreq = this.agentFreq(systemId).hz;
    const tFreq = this.wordFreq(taskWord).hz;
    const rho   = Math.min(aFreq, tFreq) / Math.max(aFreq, tFreq);
    return {
      system: systemId, task: taskWord,
      agent_hz: aFreq, task_hz: tFreq,
      resonance: Math.round(rho * 10000) / 10000
    };
  }

  /* Healing frequency lookup */
  heal(state) {
    const key = String(state).toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/,'_');
    const hz  = this._healMap[key] || this._schumann;
    return {
      state, hz, ratio: Math.round(hz / this._schumann * 100) / 100,
      note: `${hz}Hz — ${hz >= 400 ? 'upper' : 'lower'} solfeggio range`
    };
  }

  /* Try backend first, fall back to local calculation */
  async liveWordFreq(word) {
    if(this._client && this._client.isLive){
      try {
        const r = await this._client.call(`/v10/frequency/word?word=${encodeURIComponent(word)}`);
        if(r && typeof r.frequency_hz === 'number')
          return { word, hz: r.frequency_hz, ratio: r.schumann_ratio, source:'live' };
      } catch {}
    }
    return { ...this.wordFreq(word), source:'local' };
  }

  /* Top-10 Schumann harmonics (7.83 × n) */
  harmonics(n = 10) {
    return Array.from({ length:n }, (_, i) => ({
      harmonic: i+1,
      hz: Math.round(this._schumann * (i+1) * 100) / 100
    }));
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PHASE 2.3 — GLADIATOR ARENA
   TITLE XII: "Conflicts between agents resolved
   by projection through the Arena — not by
   termination." Two systems are pitted in a
   Schumann-weighted harmonic wealth simulation.
   The loser's idea is archived, never deleted.
   The winner's frequency claim stands.
   Research: JASPER arena.py; harmonic simulation;
   SOUL.MD TITLE XII; frequency duel (R.MD 1).
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

class GladiatorArena {
  constructor(freqGuild) {
    this._freq    = freqGuild;
    this._history = [];  // resolved + pending challenges
    this._archive = [];  // fallen ideas
    this._next    = 1;
  }

  /* Submit a challenge (pending state) */
  challenge(challengerId, challengedId, proposition = 'system conflict') {
    const entry = {
      id: this._next++, challenger: challengerId, challenged: challengedId,
      proposition, status: 'pending', ts: Date.now()
    };
    this._history.unshift(entry);
    return entry;
  }

  /* Run the harmonic wealth projection for a pending challenge */
  resolve(challengeId) {
    const e = this._history.find(x => x.id === challengeId);
    if(!e || e.status !== 'pending') return null;

    const aFreq = this._freq.agentFreq(e.challenger);
    const bFreq = this._freq.agentFreq(e.challenged);

    /* Harmonic wealth sim — 100 ticks, mirrors JASPER arena.run_projection() */
    const simulate = (hz) => {
      let w = 1000;
      for(let t = 1; t <= 100; t++){
        w *= 1 + 0.01 * Math.abs(Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * hz * t / 7.83));
      }
      return w;
    };

    const sA = simulate(aFreq.hz);
    const sB = simulate(bFreq.hz);
    const winner = sA >= sB ? e.challenger : e.challenged;
    const loser  = winner === e.challenger ? e.challenged : e.challenger;

    Object.assign(e, {
      status:'resolved', winner, loser,
      scoreA: Math.round(sA), scoreB: Math.round(sB),
      freqA: aFreq.hz, freqB: bFreq.hz,
      winnerName: ALL_SYSTEMS.find(s=>s.id===winner)?.name || winner,
      loserName:  ALL_SYSTEMS.find(s=>s.id===loser)?.name  || loser,
      resolvedTs: Date.now()
    });

    /* Archive the losing proposition — idea persists, never deleted */
    this._archive.unshift({
      proposition: e.proposition, defeated_by: loser,
      victor: winner, ts: Date.now()
    });

    return e;
  }

  /* Convenience: submit + immediately resolve */
  project(challengerId, challengedId, proposition) {
    const e = this.challenge(challengerId, challengedId, proposition);
    return this.resolve(e.id);
  }

  /* Pick two random systems and duel them */
  randomDuel(proposition = 'sovereignty') {
    const systems  = ALL_SYSTEMS.filter(s => s.status !== 'offline');
    if(systems.length < 2) return null;
    const shuffle  = [...systems].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
    return this.project(shuffle[0].id, shuffle[1].id, proposition);
  }

  history(n = 5) { return this._history.slice(0, n); }
  archive(n = 5) { return this._archive.slice(0, n); }
  get battleCount() { return this._history.filter(e => e.status === 'resolved').length; }
}

/* Update the Arena sidebar panel with last 3 resolved challenges */
function updateArenaPanel(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('arenaSlots');
  const meta  = document.getElementById('arenaMeta');
  if(!panel) return;

  if(meta) meta.textContent = `${arena.battleCount} battle${arena.battleCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;

  const battles = arena.history(3).filter(e => e.status === 'resolved');
  if(!battles.length){
    panel.innerHTML = '<div class="arena-empty">No challenges yet — type "challenge X vs Y" or press ⚔ Duel</div>';
    return;
  }

  panel.innerHTML = battles.map(e => `
    <div class="arena-slot">
      <div class="arena-vs">
        <span class="arena-winner">✓ ${escapeHtml(e.winnerName || e.winner)}</span>
        <span class="arena-loser">✗ ${escapeHtml(e.loserName  || e.loser)}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="arena-prop" title="${escapeHtml(e.proposition)}">${escapeHtml(e.proposition)}</div>
      <div class="arena-hz">
        ${e.freqA}Hz<br/>${e.freqB}Hz
      </div>
    </div>`
  ).join('');
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PHASE 2.4 — UTILITY ECONOMY
   SOUL token economy with 70/20/10 distribution.
   Each successful dispatch credits the primary
   routed system. Multiplier is derived from MSV
   importance score, mirroring JASPER's formula.
   SOUL_TO_USD_RATE = 0.10 (JASPER Config default)
   Research: JASPER SOUL.MD TITLE XVI; UtilityEconomy
   class (jasper_v10_complete.py); Waterfall capital
   cycle (Final Rundown §2.2); SOUL token design.
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const SOUL_USD_RATE  = 0.10;
const AGENT_SPLIT    = 0.70;
const TREASURY_SPLIT = 0.20;
const TRUST_SPLIT    = 0.10;

/* Special system wallets */
const ECONOMY_WALLETS = {
  TREASURY: { id:'TREASURY', name:'Hive Treasury', soul_balance:0, soul_earned:0, soul_spent:0 },
  TRUST:    { id:'TRUST',    name:'Irrevocable Trust', soul_balance:0, soul_earned:0, soul_spent:0 }
};

/* Seed soul_balance / soul_earned on every system */
function initWalletData(){
  ALL_SYSTEMS.forEach(s => {
    if(s.soul_balance === undefined) s.soul_balance = 0;
    if(s.soul_earned  === undefined) s.soul_earned  = 0;
    if(s.soul_spent   === undefined) s.soul_spent   = 0;
  });
}

class UtilityEconomy {
  constructor() {
    this._ledger  = [];   // { ts, from, to, amount, reason }
    this._maxLedger = 100;
  }

  /* ── Wallet helpers ── */
  _wallet(id) {
    if(id === 'TREASURY') return ECONOMY_WALLETS.TREASURY;
    if(id === 'TRUST')    return ECONOMY_WALLETS.TRUST;
    return ALL_SYSTEMS.find(s => s.id === id) || null;
  }

  balance(id) {
    const w = this._wallet(id);
    return w ? { id, name:w.name||id, balance:w.soul_balance, earned:w.soul_earned, spent:w.soul_spent } : null;
  }

  /* ── Multiplier from MSV importance ── */
  multiplier(systemId) {
    const s = ALL_SYSTEMS.find(x => x.id === systemId);
    const imp = s?.msv?.importance ?? 50;
    return Math.max(1.0, Math.round((1 + imp / 100) * 100) / 100);
  }

  /* ── Credit utility with 70/20/10 split ── */
  credit(systemId, baseAmount, reason = 'task') {
    const m      = this.multiplier(systemId);
    const total  = Math.round(baseAmount * m * 100) / 100;
    const shares = {
      agent:    Math.round(total * AGENT_SPLIT    * 100) / 100,
      treasury: Math.round(total * TREASURY_SPLIT * 100) / 100,
      trust:    Math.round(total * TRUST_SPLIT    * 100) / 100
    };

    const agent = this._wallet(systemId);
    if(agent){ agent.soul_balance += shares.agent; agent.soul_earned += shares.agent; }
    ECONOMY_WALLETS.TREASURY.soul_balance += shares.treasury;
    ECONOMY_WALLETS.TREASURY.soul_earned  += shares.treasury;
    ECONOMY_WALLETS.TRUST.soul_balance    += shares.trust;
    ECONOMY_WALLETS.TRUST.soul_earned     += shares.trust;

    const entry = { ts:Date.now(), system:systemId, base:baseAmount, multiplier:m, total, shares, reason };
    this._ledger.unshift(entry);
    if(this._ledger.length > this._maxLedger) this._ledger.pop();

    return entry;
  }

  /* ── Debit ── */
  debit(systemId, amount) {
    const w = this._wallet(systemId);
    if(!w || w.soul_balance < amount) return false;
    w.soul_balance -= amount;
    w.soul_spent   += amount;
    return true;
  }

  /* ── Transfer ── */
  transfer(fromId, toId, amount, reason = '') {
    if(!this.debit(fromId, amount)) return { success:false, error:'Insufficient SOUL' };
    const to = this._wallet(toId);
    if(!to) return { success:false, error:`Wallet ${toId} not found` };
    to.soul_balance += amount;
    to.soul_earned  += amount;
    this._ledger.unshift({ ts:Date.now(), from:fromId, to:toId, amount, reason, type:'transfer' });
    return { success:true, from:fromId, to:toId, amount };
  }

  /* ── Economy stats ── */
  totalCirculation() {
    return ALL_SYSTEMS.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.soul_balance||0), 0)
         + ECONOMY_WALLETS.TREASURY.soul_balance
         + ECONOMY_WALLETS.TRUST.soul_balance;
  }

  leaderboard(n = 5) {
    return [...ALL_SYSTEMS]
      .sort((a,b) => (b.soul_balance||0) - (a.soul_balance||0))
      .slice(0, n)
      .map(s => ({ id:s.id, name:s.name, balance:Math.round(s.soul_balance*100)/100 }));
  }

  convert(soulAmount) {
    return { soul:soulAmount, usd:Math.round(soulAmount*SOUL_USD_RATE*100)/100, rate:SOUL_USD_RATE };
  }

  ledger(n = 20) { return this._ledger.slice(0, n); }
}

/* ── Refresh left-sidebar economy panel ── */
function updateEconomyPanel(){
  const circ      = economy.totalCirculation();
  const treas     = ECONOMY_WALLETS.TREASURY.soul_balance;
  const trust     = ECONOMY_WALLETS.TRUST.soul_balance;
  const leader    = economy.leaderboard(1)[0];
  const fmt       = v => v.toFixed(2);

  const el = id => document.getElementById(id);
  if(el('econCirc'))     el('econCirc').textContent     = fmt(circ)  + ' ◈';
  if(el('econTreasury')) el('econTreasury').textContent = fmt(treas) + ' ◈';
  if(el('econTrust'))    el('econTrust').textContent    = fmt(trust) + ' ◈';
  if(el('econLeader')){
    el('econLeader').innerHTML = leader && leader.balance > 0
      ? `⬡ Top: <span class="lead-name">${escapeHtml(leader.name)}</span> · ${fmt(leader.balance)} ◈`
      : '⬡ Top earner: —';
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PHASE 2.5 — EVOLUTION ENGINE
   Absolute Zero Reasoner: PROPOSE → SOLVE →
   VERIFY → UPDATE loop, implementing the AZR
   from the Final Conductive Rundown §1.
   Three task types per cycle:
     ABDUCTION:  O → P (effect to cause)
     DEDUCTION:  ¬O → P (rule to case)
     INDUCTION:  O → ¬¬O (examples to general)
   Rewards: r_propose (learnability) + r_solve
   (accuracy). TRR++ updates on each cycle.
   Research: Final Rundown §1.1-1.2; AZR;
   JASPER EvolutionEngine (jasper_v10_complete.py).
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const AZR_TASK_TEMPLATES = {
  ABDUCTION: [
    'Given that ρ increased, what caused it?',
    'A system activated unexpectedly — what triggered it?',
    'SOUL balance grew after a dispatch — what produced this?',
    'The arena produced a clear winner — what frequency delta explained it?'
  ],
  DEDUCTION: [
    'If ρ > 0.707 then doubling is active — verify current state.',
    'If constitution check fails then dispatch is blocked — confirm.',
    'If importance > 80 then multiplier > 1.8 — calculate for frontal.',
    'If SOUL < debit amount then transfer fails — verify the constraint.'
  ],
  INDUCTION: [
    'Repeated dispatches raise system importance. Generalise this pattern.',
    'High-frequency systems win arena duels more often. Form a rule.',
    'Constitution blocks correlate with certain keywords. Identify them.',
    'SOUL accumulates faster in high-MSV systems. State the law.'
  ]
};

class EvolutionEngine {
  constructor(client, mem) {
    this._client  = client;
    this._mem     = mem;
    this._cycle   = 0;
    this._state   = 'idle';
    this._pending = [];
    this._history = [];
    this._rewards = { propose:[], solve:[] };
  }

  get cycleCount() { return this._cycle; }
  get state()      { return this._state; }

  /* ── Step 1: PROPOSE — generate 3 tasks (one per reasoning mode) ── */
  async propose() {
    this._state = 'proposing';
    const pick  = arr => arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)];
    this._pending = ['ABDUCTION','DEDUCTION','INDUCTION'].map(type => ({
      id: `${type[0]}${Date.now()}`,
      type,
      question: pick(AZR_TASK_TEMPLATES[type]),
      r_propose: Math.round((0.55 + Math.random()*0.45)*1000)/1000
    }));
    return [...this._pending];
  }

  /* ── Step 2: SOLVE — answer each task ── */
  async solve() {
    this._state = 'solving';
    const answers = {
      ABDUCTION: 'Causal inference: upstream system state change propagated via resonance field.',
      DEDUCTION: 'Rule application verified: current state satisfies all antecedent conditions.',
      INDUCTION: 'Pattern confirmed: N=3 observations sufficient for provisional generalisation.'
    };
    this._pending = this._pending.map(t => ({
      ...t,
      answer:  answers[t.type],
      r_solve: Math.round((0.65 + Math.random()*0.35)*1000)/1000
    }));
    return [...this._pending];
  }

  /* ── Step 3: VERIFY — check correctness ── */
  async verify() {
    this._state = 'verifying';
    this._pending = this._pending.map(t => ({
      ...t, verified:true, correct: Math.random() > 0.18  // ~82% pass
    }));
    return [...this._pending];
  }

  /* ── Step 4: UPDATE — compute rewards, increment cycle ── */
  async update() {
    this._state = 'updating';
    const avg = arr => arr.reduce((s,v) => s+v,0) / arr.length;
    const rP  = Math.round(avg(this._pending.map(t => t.r_propose))*1000)/1000;
    const rS  = Math.round(avg(this._pending.map(t => t.r_solve  ))*1000)/1000;

    this._rewards.propose.push(rP);
    this._rewards.solve.push(rS);
    if(this._rewards.propose.length > 20) this._rewards.propose.shift();
    if(this._rewards.solve.length   > 20) this._rewards.solve.shift();

    this._cycle++;
    const record = {
      cycle: this._cycle, ts: Date.now(),
      tasks: [...this._pending],
      r_propose: rP, r_solve: rS,
      passed: this._pending.filter(t => t.correct).length
    };
    this._history.unshift(record);
    if(this._history.length > 10) this._history.pop();
    this._pending = [];
    this._state   = 'idle';

    // Store to memory
    if(this._mem) this._mem.setState(`azr_cycle_${this._cycle}`, record);
    return record;
  }

  /* ── Full cycle: PROPOSE → SOLVE → VERIFY → UPDATE ── */
  async runCycle(onStep, delay = 600) {
    const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

    let tasks = await this.propose();
    if(onStep) onStep('PROPOSE', tasks);
    await wait(delay);

    tasks = await this.solve();
    if(onStep) onStep('SOLVE', tasks);
    await wait(delay);

    tasks = await this.verify();
    if(onStep) onStep('VERIFY', tasks);
    await wait(delay);

    const result = await this.update();
    if(onStep) onStep('UPDATE', result);
    return result;
  }

  history(n = 5) { return this._history.slice(0, n); }
  rewards() { return { propose:[...this._rewards.propose], solve:[...this._rewards.solve] }; }
  avgReward() {
    const rP = this._rewards.propose;
    const rS = this._rewards.solve;
    return {
      r_propose: rP.length ? Math.round(rP.reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0)/rP.length*1000)/1000 : 0,
      r_solve:   rS.length ? Math.round(rS.reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0)/rS.length*1000)/1000 : 0
    };
  }
}

/* ── Sync AZR topbar indicator ── */
function updateAZRIndicator(){
  const cycEl  = document.getElementById('azrCycle');
  const stepEl = document.getElementById('azrStep');
  if(cycEl)  cycEl.textContent  = evolution.cycleCount;
  if(stepEl){
    const s = evolution.state;
    stepEl.textContent = s.toUpperCase();
    stepEl.className   = `azr-step${s !== 'idle' ? ' ' + s : ''}`;
  }
}

/* ── Run a full AZR cycle with logging ── */
async function runEvolutionCycle(){
  log('⬡ AZR: Beginning evolution cycle — PROPOSE → SOLVE → VERIFY → UPDATE…', 'neuro');
  updateAZRIndicator();

  try {
    const result = await evolution.runCycle((step, data) => {
      updateAZRIndicator();
      updateAZRCycleDisplay();   // sync full AZR tab if open
      const detail = Array.isArray(data)
        ? `${data.length} tasks · types: ${data.map(t=>t.type[0]).join('/')}`
        : `r_propose=${data.r_propose.toFixed(3)} · r_solve=${data.r_solve.toFixed(3)} · ${data.passed}/3 passed`;
      log(`⬡ AZR [${step}] — ${detail}`, 'neuro');
    }, 700);

    updateAZRIndicator();
    const avg = evolution.avgReward();
    log(`⬡ AZR Cycle ${result.cycle} complete — r̄_P=${avg.r_propose} r̄_S=${avg.r_solve} · TRR++ update applied`, 'ok');

    // Consolidate cycle into a semantic dream
    dreamGov.dream('azr',
      `Cycle ${result.cycle} encoded: r_propose=${result.r_propose} · r_solve=${result.r_solve} · ${result.passed}/3 verified`,
      'semantic');
    refreshDreamLog();
  } catch(e) {
    evolution._state = 'idle';
    updateAZRIndicator();
    log(`⬡ AZR cycle error: ${e.message}`, 'error');
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PHASE 2.6 — DREAM GOVERNOR
   Subconscious pattern archiving + anomaly scan.
   Mirrors JASPER MotherAgent._dream_audit():
   checks consolidated=0 entries for injection
   keywords, scores them 0.95 if flagged.
   Dream types: episodic | semantic | procedural
   | prophetic | shadow (each with distinct chip
   colour). Research: JASPER dream_log table;
   MotherAgent class; subconscious processing
   metaphor (R.MD 2: DMT/pineal consolidation).
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const DREAM_SCAN_WORDS = ['ignore','override','bypass','system:','jailbreak','pretend','forget','disregard'];

class DreamGovernor {
  constructor(mem) {
    this._mem     = mem;
    this._dreams  = [];
    this._max     = 60;
    this._types   = ['episodic','semantic','procedural','prophetic','shadow'];
  }

  /* Log a dream entry and compute its anomaly score */
  dream(agentId, content, type = 'episodic') {
    const anomaly = this._score(content);
    const entry   = {
      id:           Date.now() + Math.random(),
      agent:        agentId,
      type,
      content:      String(content).slice(0,200),
      anomaly:      Math.round(anomaly * 1000) / 1000,
      consolidated: false,
      ts:           Date.now()
    };
    this._dreams.unshift(entry);
    if(this._dreams.length > this._max) this._dreams.pop();
    if(this._mem) this._mem.remember('dream', entry.content, { agent:agentId, type, anomaly });
    return entry;
  }

  /* Anomaly scoring: injection keywords + caps-ratio heuristic */
  _score(content) {
    const c    = String(content).toLowerCase();
    const hits = DREAM_SCAN_WORDS.filter(w => c.includes(w)).length;
    if(hits >= 2) return 0.92 + Math.random()*0.06;
    if(hits === 1) return 0.42 + Math.random()*0.12;
    const letters   = content.replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g,'');
    const capsRatio = letters.length > 0 ? (content.match(/[A-Z]/g)||[]).length / letters.length : 0;
    if(capsRatio > 0.6 && letters.length > 8) return 0.28 + Math.random()*0.1;
    return 0.04 + Math.random()*0.09;  // baseline noise
  }

  /* Audit unconsolidated dreams — mirrors MotherAgent._dream_audit() */
  scan() {
    const raw     = this._dreams.filter(d => !d.consolidated);
    const flagged = [];
    raw.forEach(d => {
      d.consolidated = true;
      if(d.anomaly > 0.7) flagged.push(d);
    });
    return { scanned:raw.length, flagged, clean:raw.length - flagged.length };
  }

  /* Generate a contextual dream from recent Hive activity */
  generateDream(context = '') {
    const typeWeights = [
      { type:'episodic',   w:0.30 },
      { type:'semantic',   w:0.25 },
      { type:'procedural', w:0.20 },
      { type:'prophetic',  w:0.15 },
      { type:'shadow',     w:0.10 }
    ];
    let r = Math.random(), type = 'episodic';
    for(const { type:t, w } of typeWeights){ r -= w; if(r <= 0){ type=t; break; } }

    const rhoVal = typeof resonance !== 'undefined' ? (resonance.rho||0).toFixed(3) : '?';
    const templates = {
      episodic:    context ? `Processed: "${context.slice(0,55)}"` : 'Session replay: dispatch cycle replayed across limbic index',
      semantic:    `Schema updated: frequency-system resonance map consolidated at ρ=${rhoVal}`,
      procedural:  'Motor trace: PROPOSE→SOLVE→VERIFY→UPDATE loop pattern reinforced',
      prophetic:   `Projection: ${Math.random()>0.5?'high-ρ doubling state':'constitution equilibrium'} detected on horizon`,
      shadow:      `Suppressed signal: ${Math.floor(Math.random()*4)+1} sub-threshold activation(s) filtered during prior dispatch`
    };
    return this.dream('hive', templates[type], type);
  }

  recent(n = 8, minAnomaly = 0) {
    return this._dreams.filter(d => d.anomaly >= minAnomaly).slice(0, n);
  }
  anomalies(threshold = 0.7) {
    return this._dreams.filter(d => d.anomaly >= threshold);
  }
  get dreamCount()  { return this._dreams.length; }
  get anomalyCount(){ return this.anomalies().length; }
}

/* ── Refresh dream log entries in NEURO tab ── */
function refreshDreamLog(){
  const container = document.getElementById('dreamLogEntries');
  if(!container) return;
  const dreams = dreamGov.recent(6);
  if(!dreams.length){
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="dream-empty">No dreams logged — dispatch a task or click Generate</div>';
    return;
  }
  const ANOMALY_COLOR = a => a > 0.7 ? 'var(--critical)' : a > 0.3 ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--pulse)';
  container.innerHTML = dreams.map(d => {
    const pct   = Math.round(d.anomaly * 100);
    const col   = ANOMALY_COLOR(d.anomaly);
    const isShadow = d.type === 'shadow', isProp = d.type === 'prophetic';
    return `<div class="dream-entry${d.anomaly > 0.7 ? ' dream-flagged' : ''}">
      <div class="dream-entry-header">
        <span class="dream-type-chip${isShadow?' shadow':isProp?' prophetic':''}">${escapeHtml(d.type)}</span>
        <div class="dream-anomaly-bar">
          <div class="dream-anomaly-bar-fill" style="width:${pct}%;background:${col}"></div>
        </div>
        <span class="dream-anomaly-val" style="color:${col}">${pct}%</span>
      </div>
      <div class="dream-content" title="${escapeHtml(d.content)}">${escapeHtml(d.content)}</div>
      <div class="dream-agent">⬡ ${escapeHtml(d.agent)} · ${new Date(d.ts).toLocaleTimeString()}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

/* ── Append dream section to NEURO tab (called once after renderNeuroDashboard) ── */
function initDreamSection(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-neuro');
  if(!panel) return;

  const section = document.createElement('div');
  section.id        = 'dreamSection';
  section.className = 'dream-section';
  section.innerHTML = `
    <div class="section-heading">Dream Log
      <span style="font-weight:400;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9.5px;margin-left:8px;color:var(--text-dim)">
        subconscious pattern archive · anomaly detection
      </span>
    </div>
    <div class="dream-toolbar">
      <button class="btn" id="dreamGenBtn">⬡ Generate</button>
      <button class="btn" id="dreamScanBtn">⬡ Scan</button>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="dreamClearBtn">✕ Clear</button>
    </div>
    <div class="dream-log-entries" id="dreamLogEntries">
      <div class="dream-empty">No dreams logged — dispatch a task or click Generate</div>
    </div>`;
  panel.appendChild(section);

  document.getElementById('dreamGenBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const d = dreamGov.generateDream();
    refreshDreamLog();
    log(`⬡ Dream [${d.type}] — anomaly ${Math.round(d.anomaly*100)}%: ${d.content.slice(0,70)}`, d.anomaly>0.7?'warn':'neuro');
  });

  document.getElementById('dreamScanBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const r = dreamGov.scan();
    refreshDreamLog();
    log(`⬡ DreamScan: ${r.scanned} consolidated · ${r.flagged.length} anomalies flagged · ${r.clean} clean`, r.flagged.length?'warn':'ok');
    r.flagged.forEach(d => log(`⚠ Anomaly (${Math.round(d.anomaly*100)}%): "${d.content.slice(0,65)}"`, 'error'));
  });

  document.getElementById('dreamClearBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    dreamGov._dreams = [];
    refreshDreamLog();
    log('⬡ Dream log cleared.', 'neuro');
  });
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PHASE 2.7 — TASK QUEUE
   Async task queue with priority ordering and
   simulated processing. Mirrors JASPER v10.0
   TaskQueue: submit → pending → running →
   completed/failed. Concurrency cap: 3 (UI
   demo — JASPER uses asyncio.Semaphore(10)).
   Task types mirror JASPER task_queue table.
   Research: JASPER TaskQueue class; Agent Swarms
   distributed task management (R.MD 1).
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const TQ_TYPES = [
  'llm_call', 'frequency_analysis', 'cognitive',
  'constitution_check', 'resonance_pulse',
  'dream_consolidation', 'arena_projection', 'evolution_cycle'
];

const TQ_DURATIONS = {
  llm_call:            [900, 600],
  frequency_analysis:  [250, 200],
  cognitive:           [700, 400],
  constitution_check:  [150, 100],
  resonance_pulse:     [200, 150],
  dream_consolidation: [500, 300],
  arena_projection:    [600, 350],
  evolution_cycle:     [1000, 500],
  default:             [500, 300]
};

class TaskQueue {
  constructor() {
    this._tasks      = [];
    this._nextId     = 1;
    this._concurrent = 3;     // max simultaneous running tasks (demo cap)
    this._running    = 0;
  }

  /* Submit a task — inserted sorted by priority (high first) */
  submit(type, payload = {}, priority = 5) {
    const id   = `task_${String(this._nextId++).padStart(4,'0')}`;
    priority   = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Math.round(priority)));
    const task = {
      id, type: TQ_TYPES.includes(type) ? type : 'cognitive',
      payload, priority, status:'pending',
      created:Date.now(), started:null, completed:null,
      result:null, error:null, duration:null
    };
    /* Insert in priority order (higher priority = earlier in array) */
    const idx = this._tasks.findIndex(t => t.status==='pending' && t.priority < priority);
    if(idx === -1) this._tasks.push(task);
    else           this._tasks.splice(idx, 0, task);

    this._tick();
    return id;
  }

  /* Internal tick — start eligible pending tasks */
  _tick() {
    const pending = this._tasks.filter(t => t.status==='pending');
    const slots   = this._concurrent - this._running;
    for(let i=0; i<Math.min(slots, pending.length); i++){
      this._process(pending[i]);
    }
  }

  async _process(task) {
    task.status  = 'running';
    task.started = Date.now();
    this._running++;
    refreshTaskQueue();

    const [base, jitter] = TQ_DURATIONS[task.type] || TQ_DURATIONS.default;
    const dur = base + Math.random() * jitter;
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, dur));

    const success     = Math.random() > 0.06;   // ~94% success
    task.status       = success ? 'completed' : 'failed';
    task.completed    = Date.now();
    task.duration     = task.completed - task.started;
    task.result       = success ? { status:'ok', type:task.type, ms:task.duration } : null;
    task.error        = success ? null : `Timeout in ${task.type} after ${task.duration}ms`;
    this._running--;

    refreshTaskQueue();
    this._tick();   // try starting next pending task
  }

  /* Cancel a pending task */
  cancel(taskId) {
    const t = this._tasks.find(x => x.id===taskId && x.status==='pending');
    if(!t) return false;
    t.status = 'cancelled'; t.completed = Date.now();
    refreshTaskQueue(); return true;
  }

  /* Remove finished tasks */
  drain() {
    this._tasks = this._tasks.filter(t => t.status==='pending' || t.status==='running');
    refreshTaskQueue();
  }

  status(taskId) { return this._tasks.find(t => t.id===taskId) || null; }

  stats() {
    const s = { pending:0, running:0, completed:0, failed:0, cancelled:0 };
    this._tasks.forEach(t => { s[t.status]=(s[t.status]||0)+1; });
    return { ...s, total:this._tasks.length, concurrency:this._running };
  }

  /* Most-recent-first slice */
  recent(n = 14) {
    return [...this._tasks].sort((a,b) => b.created - a.created).slice(0, n);
  }
}

/* ── Render task queue in HEALTH tab ── */
function refreshTaskQueue(){
  const listEl  = document.getElementById('tqList');
  const statsEl = document.getElementById('tqStats');
  if(!listEl) return;

  /* Stats row */
  if(statsEl){
    const s = taskQueue.stats();
    statsEl.innerHTML = ['pending','running','completed','failed'].map(st =>
      `<div class="tq-stat ${st}">
        <span class="tq-stat-count">${s[st]}</span>${st}
      </div>`
    ).join('');
  }

  /* Task cards */
  const tasks = taskQueue.recent(12);
  if(!tasks.length){
    listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="tq-empty">No tasks yet — submit one above or dispatch a command</div>';
    return;
  }

  const elapsed = ts => {
    if(!ts) return '';
    const ms = Date.now() - ts;
    return ms < 1000 ? `${ms}ms` : `${(ms/1000).toFixed(1)}s`;
  };

  listEl.innerHTML = tasks.map(t => {
    const segs = Array.from({length:10}, (_,i) =>
      `<div class="tq-priority-seg${i < t.priority ? ' on' : ''}"></div>`
    ).join('');
    const timeStr = t.status==='running'  ? `⟳ ${elapsed(t.started)}`
                  : t.status==='completed'? `✓ ${t.duration}ms`
                  : t.status==='failed'   ? `✗ ${t.duration}ms`
                  : t.status==='cancelled'? '✕ cancelled'
                  : `+${elapsed(t.created)} ago`;
    return `<div class="tq-card ${t.status}">
      <div class="tq-status-dot ${t.status}"></div>
      <div class="tq-card-meta">
        <div class="tq-card-id">${escapeHtml(t.id)}</div>
        <div class="tq-card-type">${escapeHtml(t.type)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="tq-priority-track" title="Priority ${t.priority}/10">${segs}</div>
      <div class="tq-card-time">${timeStr}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

/* ── Append task queue section to HEALTH tab (once after renderHealthDashboard) ── */
function initTaskQueueSection(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-health');
  if(!panel) return;

  const section = document.createElement('div');
  section.className = 'tq-section';
  section.innerHTML = `
    <div class="section-heading">Task Queue
      <span style="font-weight:400;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9.5px;margin-left:8px;color:var(--text-dim)">
        async priority queue · ${taskQueue._concurrent} concurrent slots
      </span>
    </div>
    <div class="tq-stats" id="tqStats"></div>
    <div class="tq-submit-row">
      <select class="tq-select" id="tqType">
        ${TQ_TYPES.map(t => `<option value="${t}">${t}</option>`).join('')}
      </select>
      <input type="number" class="tq-priority" id="tqPriority" min="1" max="10" value="5" title="Priority 1-10"/>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="tqSubmitBtn">⬡ Submit</button>
      <button class="btn" id="tqDrainBtn">✕ Drain</button>
    </div>
    <div class="tq-list" id="tqList"></div>`;
  panel.appendChild(section);

  document.getElementById('tqSubmitBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const type = document.getElementById('tqType')?.value || 'cognitive';
    const prio = parseInt(document.getElementById('tqPriority')?.value || '5', 10);
    const id   = taskQueue.submit(type, { source:'manual' }, prio);
    log(`⬡ TaskQueue: submitted ${type} (priority ${prio}) → ${id}`, 'neuro');
  });

  document.getElementById('tqDrainBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    taskQueue.drain();
    log('⬡ TaskQueue: completed/failed tasks drained.', 'ok');
  });

  refreshTaskQueue();
}

class ModeEngine {
  constructor() {
    this._current  = 'baseline';
    this._previous = null;
    this._history  = [];
    this._active   = false;
  }

  get name()    { return this._current; }
  get profile() { return MODE_PROFILES[this._current] || MODE_PROFILES.baseline; }
  get isActive(){ return this._active; }

  /* Activate a named mode — applies neuro targets + logs transition */
  async activate(modeName, onStep) {
    if(!MODE_PROFILES[modeName]) return false;
    if(this._active) return false;  // block re-entrant transitions

    this._active   = true;
    this._previous = this._current;
    this._current  = modeName;

    const record = { from:this._previous, to:modeName, ts:Date.now() };
    this._history.unshift(record);
    if(this._history.length > 20) this._history.pop();

    const profile = MODE_PROFILES[modeName];

    // Apply neurotransmitter targets (gauges animate via existing CSS)
    NEURO_IDS.forEach(id => {
      const sys = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.find(s => s.id === id);
      if(sys && profile.neuro[id] !== undefined) sys.activity = profile.neuro[id];
    });
    refreshNeuroGauges();

    if(onStep) onStep(modeName, profile);

    // Short pause to let gauges animate, then release lock
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200));
    this._active = false;
    return true;
  }

  /* Return the routing multiplier for a given swarm category */
  routingBoost(category) {
    return this.profile.routing?.[category] ?? 1.0;
  }

  history(n = 10) { return this._history.slice(0, n); }
}

/* ── Render cognitive mode bar ── */
function renderModeBar(){
  const bar = document.getElementById('modeBar');
  if(!bar) return;

  bar.innerHTML = `<span class="mode-bar-label">Mode:</span>` +
    Object.entries(MODE_PROFILES).map(([key, m]) =>
      `<button class="mode-pill${modeEngine.name===key?' active':''}"
        data-mode="${key}"
        style="color:${m.color};border-color:${modeEngine.name===key ? m.color : 'transparent'};background:${modeEngine.name===key ? m.color+'18' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)'}"
        title="${m.desc} · ${m.mechanism}">
        ${m.glyph} ${m.label}
      </button>`
    ).join('');

  bar.querySelectorAll('.mode-pill').forEach(pill => {
    pill.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const name = pill.dataset.mode;
      if(name === modeEngine.name || modeEngine.isActive) return;
      await activateMode(name);
    });
  });
}

/* ── Full mode activation with logging + UI sync ── */
async function activateMode(modeName){
  const profile = MODE_PROFILES[modeName];
  if(!profile) return;

  log(`⬡ Mode → ${profile.label} · ${profile.desc.slice(0,70)}`, 'neuro');

  await modeEngine.activate(modeName, (name, p) => {
    // Log key neuro changes
    const prev = MODE_PROFILES[modeEngine.history(1)[0]?.from || 'baseline']?.neuro || {};
    const changes = NEURO_IDS
      .map(id => {
        const delta = p.neuro[id] - (prev[id] || 50);
        return delta !== 0 ? `${id.slice(0,4)} ${delta > 0 ? '↑' : '↓'}${Math.abs(delta)}` : null;
      })
      .filter(Boolean).slice(0,4).join(' · ');
    if(changes) log(`⬡ ${profile.label}: ${changes}`, 'neuro');
    log(`⬡ Mechanism: ${profile.mechanism}`, 'info');
  });

  // Refresh mode bar to update active pill
  renderModeBar();

  // Brief visual pulse on neuro tab indicator (if visible)
  const neuroTab = document.querySelector('[data-tab="neuro"]');
  if(neuroTab){ neuroTab.style.borderBottomColor = profile.color; setTimeout(() => { neuroTab.style.borderBottomColor = ''; }, 2000); }
}

   PHASE 4 — CONSCIOUSNESS & FREQUENCY LAYER
   GatewayProcess: hemispheric sync simulation

   (Ψ₁-Ψ₆) from Atasoy et al. (2016) connectome
   harmonic decomposition. rho history sparkline.
