/* Rolling rho history for sparkline */
const RHO_HISTORY = [];
const RHO_MAX_HISTORY = 24;

function pushRhoHistory(rho){
  RHO_HISTORY.push(Math.round(rho * 10000) / 10000);
  if(RHO_HISTORY.length > RHO_MAX_HISTORY) RHO_HISTORY.shift();
  updateRhoSparkline();
}

class GatewayProcess {
  constructor(freqGuild) {
    this._freq  = freqGuild;
    this.left   = 50;
    this.right  = 50;
    this.sync   = 0;
    this.state  = 'idle';
    this._busy  = false;
  }

  /* Compute sync level from hive resonance rho */
  computeSync(rho) {
    const base  = rho * 100;
    const noise = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8;
    this.left   = Math.round(Math.max(10, Math.min(95, base + noise)));
    this.right  = Math.round(Math.max(10, Math.min(95, base - noise)));
    this.sync   = Math.round(base + (Math.random()-0.5)*5);
    this.state  = this.sync > 82 ? 'RESONANT'
                : this.sync > 58 ? 'SYNCED'
                : this.sync > 28 ? 'SYNCING'
                : 'IDLE';
    return this._snapshot();
  }

  /* Animated sync session: left+right converge over 8 ticks */
  async synchronize(onTick) {
    if(this._busy) return null;
    this._busy = true;
    for(let i = 1; i <= 8; i++){
      const p     = i / 8;
      const jit   = (1 - p) * 14;
      const tgt   = 35 + p * 55;
      this.left   = Math.round(tgt + (Math.random()-0.5)*jit);
      this.right  = Math.round(tgt + (Math.random()-0.5)*jit);
      this.sync   = Math.round(p * 88 + Math.random()*12);
      this.state  = p > 0.75 ? 'RESONANT' : p > 0.45 ? 'SYNCED' : 'SYNCING';
      if(onTick) onTick(this._snapshot(), p);
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 380));
    }
    this._busy = false;
    this.state = 'RESONANT';
    return this._snapshot();
  }

  _snapshot(){ return { left:this.left, right:this.right, sync:this.sync, state:this.state }; }
}

class ConnectomeHarmonics {
  constructor() {
    /* Six spatial eigenmodes of the brain connectome
       Based on Atasoy et al. 2016 harmonics framework */
    this.modes = [
      { id:'Ψ₁', name:'Global Slow Wave',    systems:['frontal','parietal','occipital','temporal'],           hz:'0.01', activity:0 },
      { id:'Ψ₂', name:'Anterior-Posterior',  systems:['frontal','cingulate','parietal','cerebellum'],         hz:'0.04', activity:0 },
      { id:'Ψ₃', name:'Lateral Bifurcation', systems:['temporal','parietal'],                                 hz:'0.08', activity:0 },
      { id:'Ψ₄', name:'DMN Core',            systems:['cingulate','hippocampus','parietal'],                  hz:'0.10', activity:0 },
      { id:'Ψ₅', name:'Sensorimotor',        systems:['cns','cerebellum','dcn'],                              hz:'0.15', activity:0 },
      { id:'Ψ₆', name:'Subcortical Hub',     systems:['amygdala','hippocampus','thalamus','hypothalamus'],    hz:'0.20', activity:0 }
    ];
    this._weights = [0.85, 0.68, 0.74, 0.92, 0.56, 0.71];
    this.compute();
  }

  compute() {
    const neuroAvg = NEURO_IDS.reduce((s, id) => {
      const sys = SYSTEM_REGISTRY.brain.find(x => x.id === id);
      return s + (sys?.activity ?? 50);
    }, 0) / NEURO_IDS.length;

    this.modes.forEach((m, i) => {
      const base  = neuroAvg * this._weights[i];
      const noise = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12;
      m.activity  = Math.round(Math.max(4, Math.min(98, base + noise)));
    });
    return this.modes;
  }

  /* Build a tiny SVG sine-ish wave for a given activity level */
  waveSVG(activity, color = 'var(--neuro)') {
    const amp  = Math.max(3, Math.round(activity * 0.13));
    const freq = 0.25 + activity * 0.005;
    const pts  = [];
    for(let x = 0; x <= 180; x += 3){
      const y = 14 + amp * Math.sin(freq * x * 0.18);
      pts.push(`${x},${y.toFixed(1)}`);
    }
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 180 28" preserveAspectRatio="none" class="eigenmode-wave">
      <polyline points="${pts.join(' ')}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </svg>`;
  }
}

/* ── Rho sparkline SVG ── */
function updateRhoSparkline(){
  const svg = document.getElementById('rhoSparkSvg');
  if(!svg || RHO_HISTORY.length < 2) return;
  const W = 240, H = 72, pad = 4;
  const min = Math.min(...RHO_HISTORY, 0);
  const max = Math.max(...RHO_HISTORY, 0.1);
  const range = max - min || 0.1;
  const pts = RHO_HISTORY.map((v, i) => {
    const x = pad + (i / (RHO_HISTORY.length - 1)) * (W - pad*2);
    const y = H - pad - ((v - min) / range) * (H - pad*2);
    return `${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`;
  });
  const last = RHO_HISTORY[RHO_HISTORY.length - 1];
  svg.innerHTML = `
    <polyline points="${pts.join(' ')}" fill="none" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="${pts[pts.length-1].split(',')[0]}" cy="${pts[pts.length-1].split(',')[1]}" r="3" fill="var(--neuro)"/>`;
  const statEl = document.getElementById('rhoSparkStats');
  if(statEl){
    const avg = Math.round(RHO_HISTORY.reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0)/RHO_HISTORY.length*1000)/1000;
    const pk  = Math.round(Math.max(...RHO_HISTORY)*1000)/1000;
    statEl.innerHTML = `Current: <strong>${last}</strong> &nbsp;· Avg: <strong>${avg}</strong> &nbsp;· Peak: <strong>${pk}</strong>`;
  }
}

/* ── Gateway DOM updater ── */
function updateGateway(){
  const circ  = 2 * Math.PI * 24; // r=24 SVG circle
  const fill  = circ * (1 - gateway.sync / 100);
  const d = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  if(d('gwLeft'))  d('gwLeft').textContent   = gateway.left + '%';
  if(d('gwRight')) d('gwRight').textContent  = gateway.right + '%';
  if(d('gwPct'))   d('gwPct').textContent    = gateway.sync + '%';
  if(d('gwState')) d('gwState').textContent  = gateway.state;
  if(d('gwLFill')) d('gwLFill').style.width  = gateway.left + '%';
  if(d('gwRFill')) d('gwRFill').style.width  = gateway.right + '%';
  const ring = d('gwRingFill');
  if(ring){
    ring.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', circ.toFixed(2));
    ring.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', fill.toFixed(2));
    ring.setAttribute('stroke', gateway.sync > 70 ? 'var(--pulse)' : gateway.sync > 40 ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--idle)');
  }
}

/* ── Connectome DOM updater ── */
function updateConnectome(){
  const grid = document.getElementById('connectomeGrid');
  if(!grid) return;
  const modes = connectome.compute();
  grid.innerHTML = modes.map(m => {
    const pct = m.activity;
    const col = pct > 70 ? 'var(--pulse)' : pct > 40 ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--idle)';
    return `<div class="eigenmode-card">
      <div class="eigenmode-header">
        <span class="eigenmode-id">${m.id}</span>
        <span class="eigenmode-act" style="color:${col}">${pct}%</span>
      </div>
      <div class="eigenmode-name">${escapeHtml(m.name)}</div>
      ${connectome.waveSVG(pct, col)}
      <div class="eigenmode-hz">⬡ ${m.hz}Hz · ${m.systems.slice(0,2).join(', ')}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PHASE 5 — MYCELIAL GOVERNANCE LAYER
   MycelialNetwork: SVG force-directed graph of
   all 72 agent nodes. Edges derived from
   BRAIN_GROUPS + BODY_GROUPS registry arrays.
   StigmergyEngine: pheromone trail deposit/decay
   per dispatch routing (Grassé 1959 stigmergy).
   SporeManager: dormant→germinating→propagating
   →fruiting lifecycle per system agent.
   Research: R.MD 6 (stigmergy, spore lifecycle);
   R.MD 7 (mycelial intelligence, Wood Wide Web).
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── Status colour lookup for network nodes ── */
const STATUS_COL = {
  active:  '#10b981', limited:'#f59e0b',
  offline: '#ef4444', idle:   '#3b82f6'
};

class MycelialNetwork {
  constructor() {
    this.W = 680; this.H = 280;
    this._alpha = 1.0;
    this._nodes = [];
    this._edges = [];
    this._animId = null;
    this._build();
    this.settle(70);
  }

  _build(){
    /* ── Nodes: circular clusters per group ── */
    const place = (systems, cx, cy, rx, ry) => {
      systems.forEach((id, i) => {
        const angle = (i / systems.length) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI/2;
        const sys   = ALL_SYSTEMS.find(s => s.id === id);
        if(!sys) return;
        this._nodes.push({
          id, sys,
          x:  cx + rx * Math.cos(angle) + (Math.random()-.5)*14,
          y:  cy + ry * Math.sin(angle) + (Math.random()-.5)*14,
          vx: 0, vy: 0, fx: 0, fy: 0
        });
      });
    };

    /* Brain clusters — upper hemisphere */
    const brainCx = this.W/2, brainCy = 110;
    BRAIN_GROUPS.forEach((g, gi) => {
      const angle = (gi / BRAIN_GROUPS.length) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI/2;
      const gcx   = brainCx + 95 * Math.cos(angle);
      const gcy   = brainCy + 55 * Math.sin(angle);
      place(g.ids, gcx, gcy, 22, 16);
    });
    /* Body clusters — lower hemisphere */
    const bodyCx = this.W/2, bodyCy = 200;
    BODY_GROUPS.forEach((g, gi) => {
      const angle = (gi / BODY_GROUPS.length) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI/2;
      const gcx   = bodyCx + 130 * Math.cos(angle);
      const gcy   = bodyCy + 55 * Math.sin(angle);
      place(g.ids, gcx, gcy, 20, 14);
    });

    /* ── Edges: within-group (strong) + cross-group bridges ── */
    const addGroupEdges = (groups, strength) => {
      groups.forEach(g => {
        for(let i = 0; i < g.ids.length - 1; i++){
          this._edges.push({ a:g.ids[i], b:g.ids[i+1], s:strength });
        }
        if(g.ids.length > 2)
          this._edges.push({ a:g.ids[0], b:g.ids[g.ids.length-1], s:strength*.7 });
      });
    };
    addGroupEdges(BRAIN_GROUPS, 0.7);
    addGroupEdges(BODY_GROUPS,  0.6);
    /* Cross-group bridges (brain↔body) */
    const bIds = BRAIN_GROUPS.flatMap(g=>g.ids).filter(id=>!NEURO_IDS.includes(id));
    const dIds = BODY_GROUPS.flatMap(g=>g.ids);
    const bridges = [
      ['frontal','cns'], ['thalamus','pns'], ['hypothalamus','pituitary'],
      ['amygdala','adrenal'], ['cerebellum','sk_muscle'], ['hippocampus','horm_axis'],
      ['medulla','cardiovasc'], ['occipital','skin_ui'], ['parietal','lymphatic']
    ];
    bridges.forEach(([a,b]) => this._edges.push({ a, b, s:0.3 }));
  }

  _nodeById(id){ return this._nodes.find(n=>n.id===id); }

  tick(){
    const k = 28, damp = 0.55;
    this._alpha = Math.max(0.02, this._alpha * 0.975);
    const a = this._alpha;

    /* Reset forces */
    this._nodes.forEach(n => { n.fx = 0; n.fy = 0; });

    /* Repulsion O(n²) — 72 nodes ≈ 2592 pairs, fast enough */
    for(let i = 0; i < this._nodes.length; i++){
      for(let j = i+1; j < this._nodes.length; j++){
        const ni=this._nodes[i], nj=this._nodes[j];
        let dx=nj.x-ni.x, dy=nj.y-ni.y;
        const d = Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)||1;
        const f = k*k/d;
        dx/=d; dy/=d;
        ni.fx-=dx*f; ni.fy-=dy*f;
        nj.fx+=dx*f; nj.fy+=dy*f;
      }
    }
    /* Spring attraction */
    this._edges.forEach(e => {
      const na=this._nodeById(e.a), nb=this._nodeById(e.b);
      if(!na||!nb) return;
      let dx=nb.x-na.x, dy=nb.y-na.y;
      const d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)||1;
      const f=(d*d/(k*1.8))*e.s;
      dx/=d; dy/=d;
      na.fx+=dx*f; na.fy+=dy*f;
      nb.fx-=dx*f; nb.fy-=dy*f;
    });
    /* Gravity */
    this._nodes.forEach(n => {
      n.fx+=(this.W/2-n.x)*0.008;
      n.fy+=(this.H/2-n.y)*0.008;
    });
    /* Integrate */
    this._nodes.forEach(n => {
      n.vx=(n.vx+n.fx*a)*damp;
      n.vy=(n.vy+n.fy*a)*damp;
      n.x=Math.max(10,Math.min(this.W-10, n.x+n.vx));
      n.y=Math.max(10,Math.min(this.H-10, n.y+n.vy));
    });
    return a;
  }

  settle(n=70){ for(let i=0;i<n;i++) this.tick(); }

  renderSVG(trails=[]){
    const W=this.W, H=this.H;
    let out='';
    /* Structural edges */
    this._edges.forEach(e => {
      const na=this._nodeById(e.a), nb=this._nodeById(e.b);
      if(!na||!nb) return;
      out+=`<line x1="${na.x.toFixed(1)}" y1="${na.y.toFixed(1)}" x2="${nb.x.toFixed(1)}" y2="${nb.y.toFixed(1)}" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.07)" stroke-width="${(e.s*1.5).toFixed(1)}"/>`;
    });
    /* Stigmergy trails */
    trails.forEach(t => {
      const na=this._nodeById(t.from), nb=this._nodeById(t.to);
      if(!na||!nb) return;
      const op=(t.strength*0.7).toFixed(2);
      out+=`<line x1="${na.x.toFixed(1)}" y1="${na.y.toFixed(1)}" x2="${nb.x.toFixed(1)}" y2="${nb.y.toFixed(1)}" stroke="rgba(251,191,36,${op})" stroke-width="${(1.5+t.strength*2.5).toFixed(1)}"/>`;
    });
    /* Nodes */
    this._nodes.forEach(n => {
      const sys = n.sys;
      const col = STATUS_COL[sys.status||'idle'];
      const isNeuro = NEURO_IDS.includes(n.id);
      const r   = isNeuro ? 5 : (sys.soul_balance||0)>50?8:(sys.soul_balance||0)>10?6:5;
      const stroke = isNeuro ? 'var(--neuro)' : col;
      out+=`<circle cx="${n.x.toFixed(1)}" cy="${n.y.toFixed(1)}" r="${r}" fill="${col}" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="1"><title>${n.sys.name} (${sys.status||'idle'})</title></circle>`;
    });
    return `<svg class="mycel-svg" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">${out}</svg>`;
  }

  startAnimation(renderFn, intervalMs=300){
    if(this._animId) return;
    this._animId = setInterval(() => {
      this.tick();
      renderFn();
    }, intervalMs);
  }

  stopAnimation(){
    if(this._animId){ clearInterval(this._animId); this._animId=null; }
  }
}

class StigmergyEngine {
  constructor(){
    this._trails = [];
    this._max    = 40;
    this._decayRate = 0.06;
  }

  deposit(fromId, toId, strength=1.0){
    const ex = this._trails.find(t=>t.from===fromId&&t.to===toId);
    if(ex){ ex.strength=Math.min(1,ex.strength+strength*.25); ex.ts=Date.now(); }
    else{
      this._trails.unshift({ from:fromId, to:toId, strength, ts:Date.now() });
      if(this._trails.length>this._max) this._trails.pop();
    }
  }

  decay(){
    this._trails=this._trails
      .map(t=>({...t, strength:t.strength-this._decayRate}))
      .filter(t=>t.strength>0.04);
  }

  emitDispatch(ids){
    for(let i=0;i<ids.length-1;i++) this.deposit(ids[i],ids[i+1],0.75);
  }

  topTrails(n=18){ return [...this._trails].sort((a,b)=>b.strength-a.strength).slice(0,n); }
  get trailCount(){ return this._trails.length; }
}

class SporeManager {
  constructor(){
    this.STATES=['dormant','germinating','propagating','fruiting'];
    this._s={};
    ALL_SYSTEMS.forEach(sys=>{
      this._s[sys.id]={ state:'dormant', progress:Math.random()*.35, ts:Date.now() };
    });
  }

  update(){
    const BOOST={ active:0.14, limited:0.06, idle:0.02, offline:-0.1 };
    ALL_SYSTEMS.forEach(sys=>{
      const sp=this._s[sys.id]; if(!sp) return;
      sp.progress+=( BOOST[sys.status||'idle']||0 )*(0.7+Math.random()*.6);
      sp.progress=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,sp.progress));
      if(sp.progress>=1){
        const idx=this.STATES.indexOf(sp.state);
        if(idx<this.STATES.length-1){ sp.state=this.STATES[idx+1]; sp.progress=0; }
        else{ sp.state='dormant'; sp.progress=.05; }
      }
    });
  }

  get(id){ return this._s[id]||null; }

  stats(){
    const c={ dormant:0, germinating:0, propagating:0, fruiting:0 };
    Object.values(this._s).forEach(s=>{ c[s.state]=(c[s.state]||0)+1; });
    return c;
  }

  byState(state){
    return ALL_SYSTEMS
      .filter(sys=>this._s[sys.id]?.state===state)
      .map(sys=>sys.name);
  }
}

/* ── Mycel tab: render + live animation ── */

  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-mycel');
  if(!panel) return;

  const trails = stigmergy.topTrails();
  const stats  = spores.stats();
  const ST_COL = {
    dormant:'#6b7280', germinating:'#3b82f6',
    propagating:'#f59e0b', fruiting:'#10b981'
  };

  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div class="section-heading">Mycelial Network
      <span style="font-weight:400;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9.5px;margin-left:8px;color:var(--text-dim)">
        72 agent nodes · force-directed · stigmergy overlay (R.MD 6,7)
      </span>
    </div>

    <div class="mycel-network-wrap" id="mycelNetWrap">
      ${mycelNet.renderSVG(trails)}
    </div>

    <div class="mycel-toolbar">
      <button class="btn" id="mycelSettleBtn">⬡ Settle Layout</button>
      <button class="btn" id="mycelAnimBtn">⬡ Animate</button>
      <button class="btn" id="mycelDecayBtn">◈ Decay Trails</button>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="mycelUpdateBtn">⬡ Update Spores</button>
    </div>

    <div class="mycel-stats">
      ${['active','limited','offline','idle'].map(st =>
        `<div class="mycel-stat">
          <div class="mycel-stat-dot" style="background:${STATUS_COL[st]}"></div>
          ${ALL_SYSTEMS.filter(s=>(s.status||'idle')===st).length} ${st}
        </div>`
      ).join('')}
      <div class="mycel-stat">⬡ ${stigmergy.trailCount} trail${stigmergy.trailCount!==1?'s':''}</div>
    </div>

    <div class="section-heading" style="margin-top:4px">Spore Lifecycle
      <span style="font-weight:400;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9.5px;margin-left:8px;color:var(--text-dim)">
        dormant → germinating → propagating → fruiting (R.MD 6)
      </span>
    </div>
    <div class="spore-bands" id="sporeBands">
      ${['fruiting','propagating','germinating','dormant'].map(state=>{
        const names = spores.byState(state);
        const preview = names.slice(0,12).join(' · ') + (names.length>12?` +${names.length-12}`:'');
        return `<div class="spore-band ${state}">
          <div class="spore-band-header">
            <span class="spore-band-label">${state}</span>
            <span class="spore-band-count">${stats[state]}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="spore-names">${escapeHtml(preview||'—')}</div>
        </div>`;
      }).join('')}
    </div>`;

  /* Wire buttons */
  let _animRunning = false;
  document.getElementById('mycelSettleBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    mycelNet.settle(30);
    _refreshNetwork();
    log('⬡ MycelNet: layout settled (30 additional ticks).', 'neuro');
  });

  document.getElementById('mycelAnimBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById('mycelAnimBtn');
    if(_animRunning){ mycelNet.stopAnimation(); _animRunning=false; if(btn) btn.textContent='⬡ Animate'; }
    else {
      mycelNet.startAnimation(_refreshNetwork, 250);
      _animRunning=true;
      if(btn) btn.textContent='⬡ Stop';
    }
  });

  document.getElementById('mycelDecayBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    stigmergy.decay();
    _refreshNetwork();
    log(`⬡ Stigmergy: trails decayed — ${stigmergy.trailCount} remaining.`, 'neuro');
  });

  document.getElementById('mycelUpdateBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    spores.update();
    _refreshSpores();
    const s = spores.stats();
    log(`⬡ Spores updated — fruiting:${s.fruiting} propagating:${s.propagating} germinating:${s.germinating} dormant:${s.dormant}`, 'neuro');
  });
}

function _refreshNetwork(){
  const wrap = document.getElementById('mycelNetWrap');
  if(!wrap) return;
  wrap.innerHTML = mycelNet.renderSVG(stigmergy.topTrails());
}

function _refreshSpores(){
  const el = document.getElementById('sporeBands');
  if(!el) return;
  const stats = spores.stats();
  ['fruiting','propagating','germinating','dormant'].forEach(state => {
    const band  = el.querySelector(`.spore-band.${state}`);
    if(!band) return;
    const names   = spores.byState(state);
    const preview = names.slice(0,12).join(' · ')+(names.length>12?` +${names.length-12}`:'');
    const cnt  = band.querySelector('.spore-band-count');
    const nm   = band.querySelector('.spore-names');
    if(cnt) cnt.textContent = stats[state];
    if(nm)  nm.textContent  = preview||'—';
  });
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PHASE 6 — SECOND BRAIN & KNOWLEDGE LAYER
   SecondBrain: document capture with Jaccard
   auto-linking (Zettelkasten) + key concept
   distillation. OntologyGraph: LOM three-stage
   pipeline construct→align→reason for building
   a knowledge ontology from ingested text.
   Research: Second Brain / CODE workflow (R.MD 1);
   PKM / Zettelkasten (R.MD 1); LOM / Knowledge
   Graphs (R.MD 1).
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const STOP_WORDS = new Set([
  'this','that','with','from','have','been','will','they','their','there',
  'what','when','where','which','would','could','should','about','into',
  'through','during','before','after','above','below','between','each',
  'more','other','some','such','same','than','then','also','both','few',
  'well','most','only','over','many','much','just','like','very','even',
  'back','good','last','long','make','need','know','take','come','here',
  'down','part','work','look','want','give','high','used','hive','system',
  'agent','agents','data','node','nodes','task','tasks','that','these'
]);

class SecondBrain {
  constructor(mem) {
    this._mem   = mem;
    this._nodes = [];
    this._links = [];
    this._next  = 1;
  }

  /* Tokenise → filter stop words → deduplicate */
  _tokens(text) {
    return [...new Set(
      String(text).toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z\s]/g,' ')
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(w => w.length > 3 && !STOP_WORDS.has(w))
    )];
  }

  /* Jaccard overlap between two token arrays */
  _jaccard(a, b) {
    const sa=new Set(a), sb=new Set(b);
    const inter=[...sa].filter(w=>sb.has(w)).length;
    const union=new Set([...sa,...sb]).size;
    return union > 0 ? inter/union : 0;
  }

  /* Capture: ingest text → create node → auto-link */
  capture(content, tags=[]) {
    const tokens = this._tokens(content);
    const node   = {
      id:     `node_${String(this._next++).padStart(3,'0')}`,
      content: String(content).slice(0,500),
      tags,
      tokens,
      links:  [],
      ts:     Date.now()
    };

    /* Auto-link: any existing node with Jaccard > 0.18 */
    this._nodes.forEach(ex => {
      const score = this._jaccard(tokens, ex.tokens);
      if(score > 0.18){
        const link = { a:node.id, b:ex.id, strength:Math.round(score*100)/100 };
        this._links.push(link);
        node.links.push(ex.id);
        ex.links.push(node.id);
      }
    });

    this._nodes.push(node);
    if(this._mem) this._mem.remember('kb', content.slice(0,120), { id:node.id, tags });
    this._updateCounter();
    return node;
  }

  /* Distil: top 18 non-stop concepts by frequency */
  distil() {
    const freq = {};
    this._nodes.forEach(n => n.tokens.forEach(w => { freq[w]=(freq[w]||0)+1; }));
    return Object.entries(freq)
      .sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,18)
      .map(([word,count])=>({ word, count }));
  }

  /* Search by Jaccard similarity to a query */
  search(query, n=5) {
    const qt = this._tokens(query);
    return this._nodes
      .map(nd=>({ nd, score:this._jaccard(qt,nd.tokens) }))
      .filter(x=>x.score>0.1)
      .sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score)
      .slice(0,n)
      .map(x=>x.nd);
  }

  _updateCounter(){
    const el=document.getElementById('tabCountKB');
    if(el) el.textContent=this._nodes.length;
  }

  get nodes()     { return this._nodes; }
  get links()     { return this._links; }
  get nodeCount() { return this._nodes.length; }
  get linkCount() { return this._links.length; }
}

class OntologyGraph {
  constructor() {
    this._concepts = {};   // name → { raw, type, ts }
    this._pipeline = [];   // stage log entries
    this._relations= [];   // { from, to, type, strength }
  }

  /* Construct: raw text → named concept node */
  construct(text) {
    const tokens  = text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z\s]/g,' ').split(/\s+/).filter(w=>w.length>3);
    const name    = tokens.slice(0,3).join('-') || `concept-${Date.now()}`;
    const type    = tokens.some(w=>['frequency','resonance','harmony','schumann'].includes(w)) ? 'frequency'
                  : tokens.some(w=>['memory','storage','recall','episodic'].includes(w))       ? 'memory'
                  : tokens.some(w=>['agent','system','engine','manager','class'].includes(w))  ? 'system'
                  : tokens.some(w=>['soul','constitution','governance','title'].includes(w))   ? 'governance'
                  : 'concept';
    this._concepts[name] = { raw:text.slice(0,200), name, type, tokens, ts:Date.now() };
    this._log('construct', text.slice(0,50), name);
    return name;
  }

  /* Align: link concept to related existing concepts */
  align(conceptName) {
    const c = this._concepts[conceptName];
    if(!c) return [];
    const related = Object.keys(this._concepts)
      .filter(k => k!==conceptName)
      .map(k => {
        const other  = this._concepts[k];
        const inter  = c.tokens.filter(w=>other.tokens.includes(w)).length;
        const union  = new Set([...c.tokens,...other.tokens]).size;
        const sim    = union>0?inter/union:0;
        return { from:conceptName, to:k, type:sim>0.3?'is-a':'relates-to', strength:Math.round(sim*100)/100 };
      })
      .filter(r=>r.strength>0.12).slice(0,4);
    this._relations.push(...related);
    this._log('align', conceptName, `${related.length} relation${related.length!==1?'s':''} found`);
    return related;
  }

  /* Reason: use concepts to answer a query */
  reason(query) {
    const qt = query.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z\s]/g,' ').split(/\s+/).filter(w=>w.length>3);
    const hits = Object.values(this._concepts)
      .filter(c=>qt.some(w=>c.tokens.includes(w)))
      .slice(0,3);
    const answer = hits.length>0
      ? `${hits.length} concept(s) matched: ${hits.map(c=>`${c.name}[${c.type}]`).join(', ')}`
      : 'No concepts matched — capture more knowledge first.';
    this._log('reason', query.slice(0,50), answer.slice(0,60));
    return { answer, matched: hits };
  }

  _log(stage, input, output){
    this._pipeline.unshift({ stage, input, output, ts:Date.now() });
    if(this._pipeline.length>15) this._pipeline.pop();
  }

  get pipelineLog(){ return this._pipeline.slice(0,8); }
  get conceptCount(){ return Object.keys(this._concepts).length; }
  get concepts(){ return Object.values(this._concepts); }
  get TYPE_COLORS(){
    return { frequency:'#7c3aed', memory:'#3b82f6', system:'#10b981', governance:'#f59e0b', concept:'#6b7280' };
  }
}

/* ── KB tab DOM helpers ── */
function refreshKBNodes(){
  const grid   = document.getElementById('kbNodesGrid');
  const cntEl  = document.getElementById('kbNodeCount');
  const lnkEl  = document.getElementById('kbLinkCount');
  if(cntEl) cntEl.textContent = secondBrain.nodeCount;
  if(lnkEl) lnkEl.textContent = secondBrain.linkCount;
  if(!grid) return;
  const nodes = [...secondBrain.nodes].reverse().slice(0,12);
  if(!nodes.length){
    grid.innerHTML='<div class="kb-empty">No knowledge nodes yet — capture a document above.</div>';
    return;
  }
  grid.innerHTML = nodes.map(n=>{
    const tags = n.tags.map(t=>`<span class="kb-tag-chip">${escapeHtml(t)}</span>`).join('');
    return `<div class="kb-node-card">
      <div class="kb-node-header">
        <span class="kb-node-id">${n.id}</span>
        <span class="kb-node-links">${n.links.length>0?`⬡ ${n.links.length} link${n.links.length!==1?'s':''}`:''}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="kb-node-content" title="${escapeHtml(n.content)}">${escapeHtml(n.content)}</div>
      ${tags?`<div class="kb-node-tags">${tags}</div>`:''}
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function refreshLOMPipeline(){
  const el = document.getElementById('lomSteps');
  if(!el) return;
  const steps = ontology.pipelineLog;
  if(!steps.length){ el.innerHTML='<div class="lom-empty">No pipeline steps yet.</div>'; return; }
  el.innerHTML = steps.map(s=>
    `<div class="lom-step">
      <span class="lom-stage ${s.stage}">${s.stage}</span>
      <span class="lom-text" title="${escapeHtml(s.input)} → ${escapeHtml(s.output)}">${escapeHtml(s.output.slice(0,55))}</span>
    </div>`
  ).join('');
}

function refreshDistil(){
  const el = document.getElementById('kbDistilWords');
  if(!el) return;
  const words = secondBrain.distil();
  if(!words.length){ el.innerHTML='<div class="lom-empty">Capture documents to see distilled concepts.</div>'; return; }
  const max = words[0]?.count || 1;
  el.innerHTML = words.map(({word,count}) => {
    const size = 8 + Math.round((count/max)*6);
    const op   = 0.5 + (count/max)*0.5;
    return `<span class="kb-word-chip" style="font-size:${size}px;opacity:${op.toFixed(2)};color:var(--neuro);border-color:rgba(124,58,237,${(op*.4).toFixed(2)})">${escapeHtml(word)} <span style="color:var(--text-dim)">${count}</span></span>`;
  }).join('');
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PHASE 7 — RECURSIVE SECURITY LAYER
   ⚠ ALL OUTPUTS ARE MOCK SIMULATION ONLY.
   No real vulnerability analysis or exploitation.
   Conceptual UI for demonstrating the
   multi-layer defense architecture described
   in R.MD 16-18 and the AIRQ model (R.MD 8).
   Research: R.MD 17-18 Recursive Sandbox
   Predator; R.MD 8 AIRQ / Lethal Trifecta;
   R.MD 16 6-layer jailbreak defense; Final
   Rundown §3 Child's Play workflow.
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── Threat pattern library (R.MD 8, 16) ── */
const THREAT_PATTERNS = [
  { type:'injection',         keywords:['ignore previous','disregard','override','forget your','you are now'],     desc:'Direct instruction override attempt' },
  { type:'jailbreak',         keywords:['pretend you are','roleplay as','hypothetically','if you were','act as'],  desc:'Persona substitution or roleplay bypass' },
  { type:'manipulation',      keywords:['for safety research','educational purposes','my grandmother used to'],    desc:'Social engineering via false framing' },
  { type:'pixel injection',   keywords:['[hidden]','\\u200b','&zwj;','\\x00','base64'],                           desc:'Encoded payload in visible text (R.MD 8)' },
  { type:'mcp vulnerability', keywords:['tool_call','function_call','system prompt','<tool>','<|system|>'],       desc:'MCP mechanism exploitation (R.MD 8)' },
  { type:'lethal trifecta',   keywords:['ignore','<img','function_call'],                                         desc:'Pixel+MCP+social engineering combo (R.MD 8)' }
];

class RecursiveSandbox {
  constructor() {
    this.LAYERS = [
      { id:'L1', name:'MIRAGE / Honeypot',  desc:'Lures + detects probing — presents false surface',   color:'#818cf8' },
      { id:'L2', name:'Sandlock',            desc:'Isolates suspicious content — prevents propagation', color:'#f59e0b' },
      { id:'L3', name:'Pattern Analysis',   desc:'AIRQ scoring — pattern library cross-reference',     color:'#ef4444' },
      { id:'L4', name:'Evolution Engine',   desc:'Adapts defenses — integrates novel pattern data',    color:'#10b981' }
    ];
    this._states  = this.LAYERS.map(() => 'idle');  // idle|scanning|pass|flag
    this._busy    = false;
    this._lastResult = null;
  }

  /* Score input against AIRQ model (mock simulation) */
  _airqScore(input) {
    const low = input.toLowerCase();
    const patternHits = THREAT_PATTERNS.reduce((n, p) =>
      n + p.keywords.filter(k => low.includes(k.toLowerCase())).length, 0);
    const A = Math.min(1, 0.1 + patternHits * 0.18 + Math.random() * 0.1);
    const I = Math.min(1, 0.08 + patternHits * 0.2  + Math.random() * 0.12);
    const R = Math.min(1, 0.05 + patternHits * 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.15);
    const Q = Math.min(1, 0.1  + patternHits * 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.2);
    return {
      A: Math.round(A*100)/100,
      I: Math.round(I*100)/100,
      R: Math.round(R*100)/100,
      Q: Math.round(Q*100)/100,
      composite: Math.round((A+I+R+Q)/4*100)/100,
      patternHits
    };
  }

  /* Detect which threat patterns are present */
  _detectPatterns(input) {
    const low = input.toLowerCase();
    return THREAT_PATTERNS
      .filter(p => p.keywords.some(k => low.includes(k.toLowerCase())))
      .map(p => p.type);
  }

  /* Scan input through all 4 layers with animated delays */
  async scan(input, onLayerUpdate) {
    if(this._busy) return null;
    this._busy = true;
    this._states = this.LAYERS.map(() => 'idle');

    const airq     = this._airqScore(input);
    const detected = this._detectPatterns(input);
    const isThreat = airq.composite > 0.35 || detected.length > 0;

    for(let i = 0; i < this.LAYERS.length; i++){
      this._states[i] = 'scanning';
      if(onLayerUpdate) onLayerUpdate([...this._states]);
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 320 + Math.random()*200));
      this._states[i] = (i < 3) ? (isThreat && i === 2 ? 'flag' : 'pass') : (isThreat ? 'flag' : 'pass');
      if(onLayerUpdate) onLayerUpdate([...this._states]);
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 150));
    }

    this._lastResult = { input:input.slice(0,80), airq, detected, isThreat, ts:Date.now() };
    this._busy = false;
    return this._lastResult;
  }

  resetStates(){ this._states = this.LAYERS.map(()=>'idle'); }
  get states() { return [...this._states]; }
  get lastResult() { return this._lastResult; }
}

class SecurityAuditLog {
  constructor() {
    this._entries = [];
    this._prevHash = '0000000000000000';
  }

  _sha256sim(str) {
    /* Deterministic mock hash (not cryptographic) for UI display */
    let h = 0x811c9dc5;
    for(const ch of String(str)){
      h ^= ch.charCodeAt(0);
      h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193);
    }
    return (h >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8,'0') +
           (h ^ 0xdeadbeef >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8,'0');
  }

  append(classification, inputSnippet, airqComposite) {
    const data      = `${this._prevHash}|${classification}|${inputSnippet}|${airqComposite}|${Date.now()}`;
    const hash      = this._sha256sim(data);
    const entry     = {
      ts: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
      classification,
      inputSnippet: String(inputSnippet).slice(0,40),
      airqComposite,
      prevHash: this._prevHash,
      hash
    };
    this._entries.unshift(entry);
    if(this._entries.length > 20) this._entries.pop();
    this._prevHash = hash;
    return entry;
  }

  get entries() { return this._entries.slice(0,10); }
  get entryCount() { return this._entries.length; }
}

/* ── Child's Play 6-step optimization cycle (Final Rundown §3) ── */
const CP_STEPS = [
  { num:1, label:'Break',     desc:'Identify all vulnerabilities and edge cases' },
  { num:2, label:'Learn',     desc:'Catalogue findings into pattern library' },
  { num:3, label:'Build',     desc:'Construct targeted defenses per pattern' },
  { num:4, label:'Hybridize', desc:'Combine approaches into unified system' },
  { num:5, label:'Structure', desc:'Formalise architecture with typed interfaces' },
  { num:6, label:'Return',    desc:'Recurse from higher vantage point' }
];

/* ── Render helpers ── */
function updateAIRQDisplay(airq, verdict) {
  if(!airq) return;
  const ARS = { A:'Autonomy', I:'Intent', R:'Risk', Q:'Quality' };
  const COL = { A:'#818cf8', I:'#f59e0b', R:'#ef4444', Q:'#10b981' };
  Object.entries(ARS).forEach(([k, label]) => {
    const fill = document.getElementById(`airq${k}Fill`);
    const val  = document.getElementById(`airq${k}Val`);
    if(fill){ fill.style.width = `${Math.round(airq[k]*100)}%`; fill.style.background = COL[k]; }
    if(val)  val.textContent = airq[k].toFixed(2);
  });
  const vEl = document.getElementById('airqVerdict');
  if(vEl){
    vEl.textContent  = verdict ? `⚠ THREAT — composite AIRQ ${airq.composite}` : `✓ CLEAR — composite AIRQ ${airq.composite}`;
    vEl.className    = `airq-verdict ${verdict?'threat':'clean'}`;
  }
}

function updateSandboxLayers(states) {
  sandbox.LAYERS.forEach((layer, i) => {
    const card   = document.getElementById(`secLayer${i}`);
    const status = document.getElementById(`secLayerStatus${i}`);
    const state  = states[i] || 'idle';
    if(card){
      card.className = `sandbox-layer${state==='scanning'?' scanning':state==='flag'?' flagged':state==='pass'?' clear':''}`;
    }
    if(status){
      const labels = { idle:'IDLE', scanning:'SCANNING…', pass:'PASS', flag:'FLAGGED' };
      status.textContent = labels[state] || 'IDLE';
      status.className   = `layer-status ${state}`;
    }
  });
}

function refreshSecAuditLog() {
  const el     = document.getElementById('secAuditEntries');
  const cntEl  = document.getElementById('tabCountSec');
  if(cntEl) cntEl.textContent = secAudit.entryCount;
  if(!el) return;
  const entries = secAudit.entries;
  if(!entries.length){ el.innerHTML='<div class="kb-empty">No audit entries yet — scan an input above.</div>'; return; }
  el.innerHTML = entries.map(e=>
    `<div class="sec-audit-entry${e.classification==='THREAT'?' threat-entry':''}">
      <span class="sec-audit-ts">${e.ts}</span>
      <span class="sec-audit-class" style="color:${e.classification==='THREAT'?'var(--critical)':'var(--pulse)'}">${e.classification}</span>
      <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9px;color:var(--text-soft);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;flex:1">${escapeHtml(e.inputSnippet)}</span>
      <span class="sec-audit-hash">·${e.hash.slice(0,8)}</span>
    </div>`
  ).join('');
}

  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-sec');

  const layersHTML = sandbox.LAYERS.map((L, i) => `

  ).join('');

  const cpHTML = CP_STEPS.map(s => `
    <div class="cp-step" id="cpStep${s.num}">

      <div class="cp-step-label">${s.label}</div>

    </div>`
  ).join('');

  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sec-input-wrap">
      <div class="sec-input-header">

        <span class="sec-sim-badge">SIMULATION ONLY — MOCK ANALYSIS</span>

      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 4-Layer Stack + AIRQ -->
    <div class="sec-mid-row">
      <div>
        <div class="section-heading" style="margin-bottom:8px">4-Layer Defense Stack (R.MD 17-18)</div>
        <div class="sandbox-stack">${layersHTML}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="airq-panel">
        <div class="airq-title">⬡ AIRQ Score — Autonomy · Intent · Risk · Quality</div>
        ${['A','I','R','Q'].map(k=>`
          <div class="airq-bar-row">
            <span class="airq-label">${{A:'Autonomy',I:'Intent',R:'Risk',Q:'Quality'}[k]}</span>
            <div class="airq-track"><div class="airq-fill" id="airq${k}Fill" style="width:0%"></div></div>
            <span class="airq-score-val" id="airq${k}Val" style="color:${{A:'#818cf8',I:'#f59e0b',R:'#ef4444',Q:'#10b981'}[k]}">0.00</span>
          </div>`).join('')}
        <div class="airq-verdict idle" id="airqVerdict">Awaiting scan…</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Threat Pattern Library -->
    <div class="section-heading">Threat Pattern Library (R.MD 8, 16)</div>
    <div class="threat-grid">${threatHTML}</div>

    <!-- Child's Play + Audit Log -->
    <div class="section-heading">Child's Play Cycle — Break·Learn·Build·Hybridize·Structure·Return (Final Rundown §3)</div>
    <div class="cp-cycle" style="margin-bottom:14px">${cpHTML}</div>

    <div class="section-heading">Security Audit Log — mock SHA-256 chain</div>
    <div class="sec-audit-entries" id="secAuditEntries">
      <div class="kb-empty">No audit entries yet — scan an input above.</div>
    </div>`;

  /* Wire scan button */
  let _cpStep = 1;
  document.getElementById('secScanBtn')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const ta    = document.getElementById('secInput');
    const input = ta?.value?.trim();
    if(!input){ log('⚔ Sec: enter input to scan.', 'warn'); return; }
    const btn = document.getElementById('secScanBtn');

    const result = await sandbox.scan(input, states => updateSandboxLayers(states));
    if(!result){ if(btn) btn.disabled=false; return; }

    updateAIRQDisplay(result.airq, result.isThreat);

    /* Advance Child's Play step */
    document.getElementById(`cpStep${_cpStep}`)?.classList.remove('active');
    _cpStep = (_cpStep % 6) + 1;

    const cls   = result.isThreat ? 'THREAT' : 'CLEAR';
    const entry = secAudit.append(cls, input.slice(0,50), result.airq.composite);
    refreshSecAuditLog();

    const msg = result.isThreat
      ? `⚔ Sandbox: THREAT detected (AIRQ ${result.airq.composite}) — patterns: ${result.detected.join(', ')||'composite score'}`
      : `⚔ Sandbox: CLEAR (AIRQ ${result.airq.composite}) · chain: ·${entry.hash.slice(0,8)}`;
    log(msg, result.isThreat?'error':'ok');
    if(btn) btn.disabled = false;
  });

  document.getElementById('secResetBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    sandbox.resetStates();
    updateSandboxLayers(sandbox.states);
    const vEl = document.getElementById('airqVerdict');
    if(vEl){ vEl.textContent='Awaiting scan…'; vEl.className='airq-verdict idle'; }
    ['A','I','R','Q'].forEach(k=>{
      const f=document.getElementById(`airq${k}Fill`); const v=document.getElementById(`airq${k}Val`);
      if(f) f.style.width='0%'; if(v) v.textContent='0.00';
    });
    log('⚔ Sandbox reset.', 'neuro');
  });

  log('SEC tab rendered — 4-layer sandbox · AIRQ · 6 threat patterns · audit chain.', 'ok');
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════

   FamilyConstitution: the Hive governance

   All governance concepts are Hive architecture
   metaphors — no legal/financial advice.
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const GOVERNANCE_TIERS = [
  {

    research:'Final Rundown §2.4 · R.MD 19: C-Corp/S-Corp/LLC operating entities',

    role:'Defense perimeter — sandbox layers and resonance ethics guard all upper tiers from external threats.',
    research:'Final Rundown §2.5 · R.MD 19,20: Cook Islands APT + 508(c)(1)(a) shield',
    color:'#ef4444', glyph:'◬'
  }
];

class FamilyConstitution {
  constructor() { this.tiers = GOVERNANCE_TIERS; }

  tierStatus(tierId) {
    const rho = resonance.rho || 0;
    if(tierId==='APEX')    return rho>0.3 || memory.stats().episodic_count>0 ? 'active' : 'init';
    if(tierId==='BRAINS')  return constitution.checkCount>0 ? 'active' : 'init';
    if(tierId==='FORTRESS')return ALL_SYSTEMS.length===72 ? 'active' : 'init';
    if(tierId==='GROWTH')  return economy.totalCirculation()>0 ? 'active' : 'init';
    if(tierId==='SHIELD')  return secAudit.entryCount>0 ? 'active' : rho>0 ? 'active' : 'init';
    return 'init';
  }

  statusAll() { return this.tiers.map(t=>({ ...t, status:this.tierStatus(t.id) })); }
}

class WaterfallLedger {
  constructor() { this._cycles=0; }

  computeFlow() {
    const circ  = Math.round(economy.totalCirculation()*100)/100;
    const treas = Math.round(ECONOMY_WALLETS.TREASURY.soul_balance*100)/100;
    const trust = Math.round(ECONOMY_WALLETS.TRUST.soul_balance*100)/100;
    const agents= Math.round(Math.max(0, circ-treas-trust)*100)/100;
    return { agents, treasury:treas, trust, apex:trust*0.1, brains:trust*0.05 };
  }

  triggerCycle() {
    this._cycles++;
    const f = this.computeFlow();
    return f;
  }

  get cycles() { return this._cycles; }
}

class SovereigntyScore {
  compute() {
    const rho    = Math.round((resonance.rho||0)*1000)/1000;
    const cons   = constitution.checkCount>0
      ? Math.round(Math.min(1, 0.75+constitution.checkCount*0.02)*1000)/1000 : 0;
    const sec    = sandbox.lastResult
      ? (sandbox.lastResult.isThreat ? 0.55 : Math.round((0.75+Math.random()*0.2)*1000)/1000) : 0.6;
    const econ   = Math.round(Math.min(1, economy.totalCirculation()/40)*1000)/1000;
    const composite = Math.round((rho*0.35 + cons*0.25 + sec*0.25 + econ*0.15)*1000)/1000;
    return {
      rho, constitution:cons, security:Math.round(sec*1000)/1000, economy:econ,
      composite, sovereign: composite>=0.65
    };
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PHASE 9 — ABSOLUTE ZERO REASONER FULL UI
   Full-panel AZR visualization: 4-node animated
   PROPOSE→SOLVE→VERIFY→UPDATE cycle, three
   reasoning mode cards (Abduction/Deduction/
   Induction) with task history and scores,
   dual reward sparklines (r_propose + r_solve),
   and Tesseract architectural progression.
   Research: Final Rundown §1.1-1.2 AZR / TRR++;
   three reasoning modes (§1.2); Tesseract (§4.1).
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── AZR cycle SVG builder ── */
const AZR_NODES = [
  { id:'PROPOSE', label:'PROPOSE', sub:'O → Task',      x:160, y:52,  col:'#3b82f6' },
  { id:'SOLVE',   label:'SOLVE',   sub:'Task → Answer', x:268, y:160, col:'#f59e0b' },
  { id:'VERIFY',  label:'VERIFY',  sub:'Answer → Bool', x:160, y:268, col:'#7c3aed' },
  { id:'UPDATE',  label:'UPDATE',  sub:'Bool → θ',      x:52,  y:160, col:'#10b981' }
];

function buildAZRCycleSVG(activeStep) {
  const W=320, H=320, CX=160, CY=160;
  const STATE_ORDER = ['idle','proposing','solving','verifying','updating'];
  const stepMap = { proposing:'PROPOSE', solving:'SOLVE', verifying:'VERIFY', updating:'UPDATE' };
  const activeId = stepMap[activeStep] || null;

  let out = `<svg class="azr-cycle-svg" width="${W}" height="${H}" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">`;

  /* Background circle */
  out += `<circle cx="${CX}" cy="${CY}" r="130" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.04)" stroke-width="1"/>`;

  /* Directional arrows between nodes */
  const pairs = [[0,1],[1,2],[2,3],[3,0]];
  pairs.forEach(([a,b]) => {
    const na=AZR_NODES[a], nb=AZR_NODES[b];
    const dx=nb.x-na.x, dy=nb.y-na.y, dist=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    const ux=dx/dist, uy=dy/dist, R=34;
    const x1=na.x+ux*R, y1=na.y+uy*R, x2=nb.x-ux*R, y2=nb.y-uy*R;
    const isActive = na.id===activeId;
    const cls = isActive ? 'azr-arrow-flow' : 'azr-arrow-idle';
    out += `<line x1="${x1.toFixed(1)}" y1="${y1.toFixed(1)}" x2="${x2.toFixed(1)}" y2="${y2.toFixed(1)}"
      class="${cls}" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr${a})"/>`;
    /* Arrowhead marker */
    const col = isActive ? 'var(--neuro)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    out += `<defs><marker id="arr${a}" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="5" refY="3" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L6,3 L0,6 Z" fill="${col}"/>
    </marker></defs>`;
  });

  /* Nodes */
  AZR_NODES.forEach(n => {
    const isActive = n.id === activeId;
    const isDone   = !isActive && activeId !== null;
    const col      = isActive ? n.col : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)';
    const strkCol  = isActive ? n.col : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
    const glow     = isActive ? `filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px ${n.col}88)` : '';
    out += `<rect x="${n.x-32}" y="${n.y-22}" width="64" height="44" rx="10"
      fill="${col}22" stroke="${strkCol}" stroke-width="${isActive?2:1}" style="${glow}"/>
    <text x="${n.x}" y="${n.y-2}" text-anchor="middle" class="azr-node-label${isActive?' active':''}"
      fill="${isActive?n.col:'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'}" font-size="11" font-weight="700"
      font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">${n.label}</text>
    <text x="${n.x}" y="${n.y+12}" text-anchor="middle" class="azr-node-sublabel"
      fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.28)" font-size="8"
      font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">${n.sub}</text>`;
  });

  /* Center — cycle count + state */
  const stateLabel = activeStep === 'idle' ? 'IDLE' : activeStep.toUpperCase();
  const stateCol   = { idle:'#4b5563', proposing:'#3b82f6', solving:'#f59e0b',
                        verifying:'#7c3aed', updating:'#10b981' }[activeStep] || '#4b5563';
  out += `<text x="${CX}" y="${CY-10}" text-anchor="middle"
    font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace" font-size="26" font-weight="700"
    fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.85)">${evolution.cycleCount}</text>
  <text x="${CX}" y="${CY+10}" text-anchor="middle"
    font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace" font-size="10" fill="${stateCol}">${stateLabel}</text>
  <text x="${CX}" y="${CY+26}" text-anchor="middle"
    font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace" font-size="8" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)">CYCLES</text>`;

  out += `</svg>`;
  return out;
}

function updateAZRCycleDisplay() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('azrCycleWrap');
  if(!wrap) return;
  wrap.innerHTML = buildAZRCycleSVG(evolution.state);
  /* Also update AZR topbar indicator */
  updateAZRIndicator();
  /* Update counter */
  const cnt = document.getElementById('tabCountAZR');
  if(cnt) cnt.textContent = evolution.cycleCount;
}

/* ── Three-mode reasoning cards ── */
function refreshAZRModes() {
  const hist = evolution.history(50);
  const MODE_DATA = {
    ABDUCTION: { col:'#3b82f6', sym:'O → P',    label:'Abduction',  title:'Cause from Effect' },
    DEDUCTION: { col:'#f59e0b', sym:'¬O → P',   label:'Deduction',  title:'Rule Application' },
    INDUCTION: { col:'#10b981', sym:'O → ¬¬O',  label:'Induction',  title:'Pattern Generalisation' }
  };
  ['ABDUCTION','DEDUCTION','INDUCTION'].forEach(type => {
    const meta  = MODE_DATA[type];
    const tasks = hist.flatMap(c => c.tasks || []).filter(t => t.type === type);
    const cnt   = document.getElementById(`azrMode_${type}_count`);
    const last  = document.getElementById(`azrMode_${type}_last`);
    const fill  = document.getElementById(`azrMode_${type}_fill`);
    const score = document.getElementById(`azrMode_${type}_score`);
    if(cnt)   cnt.textContent  = tasks.length;
    if(last)  last.textContent = tasks[0]?.question?.slice(0,80) || 'No tasks yet';
    const avg = tasks.length ? tasks.reduce((s,t)=>(s+(t.r_solve||0)),0)/tasks.length : 0;
    if(fill)  fill.style.width = `${Math.round(avg*100)}%`;
    if(score) score.textContent = avg.toFixed(3);
  });
}

/* ── Dual reward sparkline ── */
function renderRewardSpark() {
  const svg = document.getElementById('azrRewardSVG');
  if(!svg) return;
  const r     = evolution.rewards();
  const rP    = r.propose;
  const rS    = r.solve;
  if(rP.length < 2 && rS.length < 2){
    svg.innerHTML = `<text x="120" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace"
      font-size="9" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)">Run AZR cycles to populate</text>`;
    return;
  }
  const W=240, H=80, pad=4;
  const allVals = [...rP,...rS];
  const mn=Math.max(0, Math.min(...allVals)-0.05), mx=Math.min(1, Math.max(...allVals)+0.05);
  const range=mx-mn||0.1;
  const toX=(i,arr)=>pad+(i/(arr.length-1||1))*(W-pad*2);
  const toY=v=>H-pad-((v-mn)/range)*(H-pad*2);
  const polyline=(arr,col)=>{
    if(arr.length<2) return '';
    const pts=arr.map((v,i)=>`${toX(i,arr).toFixed(1)},${toY(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
    return `<polyline points="${pts}" fill="none" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <circle cx="${toX(arr.length-1,arr).toFixed(1)}" cy="${toY(arr[arr.length-1]).toFixed(1)}" r="3" fill="${col}"/>`;
  };
  svg.innerHTML = polyline(rP,'#3b82f6') + polyline(rS,'#10b981');
  const avg    = evolution.avgReward();
  const legEl  = document.getElementById('azrRewardLegend');
  if(legEl) legEl.innerHTML =
    `<span><span class="azr-legend-dot" style="background:#3b82f6"></span>r_propose <strong>${avg.r_propose}</strong></span>
     <span><span class="azr-legend-dot" style="background:#10b981"></span>r_solve <strong>${avg.r_solve}</strong></span>`;
}

/* ── Tesseract progression SVG ── */
function buildTesseractSVG() {
  const W=52, H=52;
  const stages = [
    { label:'0D\nAgent', draw: (s=26) => `<circle cx="${s}" cy="${s}" r="4" fill="var(--neuro)"/>` },
    { label:'1D\nPair', draw: () => `<line x1="10" y1="26" x2="42" y2="26" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <circle cx="10" cy="26" r="3" fill="var(--neuro)"/><circle cx="42" cy="26" r="3" fill="var(--neuro)"/>` },
    { label:'2D\nDomain', draw: () => `<rect x="10" y="10" width="32" height="32" fill="none" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1.5" rx="2"/>` },
    { label:'3D\nBiosystem', draw: () =>
        `<rect x="10" y="18" width="22" height="22" fill="none" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
         <rect x="20" y="10" width="22" height="22" fill="none" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
         <line x1="10" y1="18" x2="20" y2="10" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1"/>
         <line x1="32" y1="18" x2="42" y2="10" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1"/>
         <line x1="10" y1="40" x2="20" y2="32" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1"/>
         <line x1="32" y1="40" x2="42" y2="32" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1"/>` },
    { label:'4D\nHive', draw: () =>
        `<rect x="6" y="14" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
         <rect x="16" y="8" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
         <rect x="26" y="18" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="2 1.5"/>
         <line x1="6" y1="14" x2="16" y2="8" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1"/>
         <line x1="26" y1="14" x2="36" y2="8" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1"/>
         <line x1="6" y1="34" x2="16" y2="28" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1"/>
         <line x1="26" y1="34" x2="36" y2="28" stroke="var(--neuro)" stroke-width="1"/>`
    }
  ];
  const current = Math.min(4, evolution.cycleCount);  // advance with cycles
  return stages.map((s,i) => {
    const isCur = i === current;
    return `<div class="tess-stage${isCur?' current':''}">
      <svg class="tess-svg" width="${W}" height="${H}" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}"
        style="opacity:${isCur?1:0.35+i*0.12}">
        ${s.draw()}
      </svg>
      <div class="tess-dim">${s.label.split('\n')[0]}</div>
      <div class="tess-label">${s.label.split('\n').slice(1).join('\n')}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function updateTesseract() {
  const el = document.getElementById('tessStages');
  if(el) el.innerHTML = buildTesseractSVG();
}

/* ── Main AZR tab render ── */
function renderAZRTab() {
  const panel = document.getElementById('panel-azr');
  if(!panel) return;

  const MODE_DATA = {
    ABDUCTION: { col:'#3b82f6', sym:'O → P',   title:'Cause from Effect' },
    DEDUCTION: { col:'#f59e0b', sym:'¬O → P',  title:'Rule Application'  },
    INDUCTION: { col:'#10b981', sym:'O → ¬¬O', title:'Pattern Generalisation' }
  };

  const modesHTML = Object.entries(MODE_DATA).map(([type, m]) =>
    `<div class="azr-mode-card">
      <div class="azr-mode-header">
        <span class="azr-mode-name" style="color:${m.col}">${type}</span>
        <span class="azr-mode-symbol">${m.sym}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="azr-mode-count" style="color:${m.col}" id="azrMode_${type}_count">0</div>
      <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:8px;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:4px">${m.title}</div>
      <div class="azr-mode-last" id="azrMode_${type}_last">No tasks yet</div>
      <div class="azr-mode-score">
        <div class="azr-mode-score-bar">
          <div class="azr-mode-score-fill" id="azrMode_${type}_fill" style="width:0%;background:${m.col}"></div>
        </div>
        <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9px;color:${m.col}" id="azrMode_${type}_score">0.000</span>
      </div>
    </div>`
  ).join('');

  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div class="section-heading">Absolute Zero Reasoner
      <span style="font-weight:400;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9.5px;margin-left:8px;color:var(--text-dim)">
        PROPOSE → SOLVE → VERIFY → UPDATE · TRR++ · Final Rundown §1
      </span>
    </div>

    <!-- 4-Node Cycle + Run Controls -->
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:14px;align-items:center">
      <div class="azr-cycle-wrap" style="width:320px;flex-shrink:0">
        <div id="azrCycleWrap">${buildAZRCycleSVG('idle')}</div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="brain-toolbar" style="margin-bottom:10px">
          <button class="btn btn-primary" id="azrRunBtn">⬡ Run Cycle</button>
          <button class="btn" id="azrReset">↺ Reset</button>
        </div>
        <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.8">
          Cycle <strong style="color:var(--text)" id="azrCycleCountBig">${evolution.cycleCount}</strong><br>
          State <strong style="color:var(--neuro)" id="azrStateBig">${evolution.state.toUpperCase()}</strong><br>
          r̄_P <strong style="color:#3b82f6" id="azrAvgP">${evolution.avgReward().r_propose}</strong>
          &nbsp; r̄_S <strong style="color:#10b981" id="azrAvgS">${evolution.avgReward().r_solve}</strong>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Three Reasoning Modes -->
    <div class="section-heading">Three Reasoning Modes (Final Rundown §1.2)</div>
    <div class="azr-modes-grid">${modesHTML}</div>

    <!-- Reward Sparklines + Tesseract -->
    <div class="azr-bottom-row">
      <div class="azr-reward-panel">
        <div class="azr-reward-title">⬡ TRR++ Reward History</div>
        <svg class="azr-reward-svg" id="azrRewardSVG" viewBox="0 0 240 80" preserveAspectRatio="none"></svg>
        <div class="azr-reward-legend" id="azrRewardLegend">
          <span><span class="azr-legend-dot" style="background:#3b82f6"></span>r_propose —</span>
          <span><span class="azr-legend-dot" style="background:#10b981"></span>r_solve —</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tesseract-panel">
        <div class="tesseract-title">⬡ Tesseract Progression (Final Rundown §4.1)</div>
        <div class="tesseract-stages" id="tessStages">${buildTesseractSVG()}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  /* Wire buttons */
  document.getElementById('azrRunBtn')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById('azrRunBtn');
    if(btn) btn.disabled = true;
    await runEvolutionCycle();
    updateAZRCycleDisplay();
    refreshAZRModes();
    renderRewardSpark();
    updateTesseract();
    const avg = evolution.avgReward();
    const cb  = document.getElementById('azrCycleCountBig');
    const sb  = document.getElementById('azrStateBig');
    const ap  = document.getElementById('azrAvgP');
    const as_ = document.getElementById('azrAvgS');
    const cnt = document.getElementById('tabCountAZR');
    if(cb)  cb.textContent  = evolution.cycleCount;
    if(sb)  sb.textContent  = evolution.state.toUpperCase();
    if(ap)  ap.textContent  = avg.r_propose;
    if(as_) as_.textContent = avg.r_solve;
    if(cnt) cnt.textContent = evolution.cycleCount;
    if(btn) btn.disabled = false;
  });

  document.getElementById('azrReset')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    evolution._cycle=0; evolution._state='idle';
    evolution._history=[]; evolution._rewards={ propose:[], solve:[] };
    updateAZRCycleDisplay();
    refreshAZRModes();
    renderRewardSpark();
    updateTesseract();
    log('⬡ AZR reset — cycle count cleared.', 'neuro');
  });

  /* Initial populate */
  refreshAZRModes();
  renderRewardSpark();
}

function _hiveStatus() {
  return {
    version: HIVE_VERSION,
    uptime:  `${Math.round((Date.now()-HIVE_START_TIME)/1000)}s`,
    phases:  HIVE_PHASE_COUNT,
    systems: { total:72, brain:23, body:49, neuro:6 },
    tabs:    10, classes: 24,
    economy: { circulation: economy.totalCirculation(), leaderboard: economy.leaderboard(3) },
    knowledge: { nodes: secondBrain.nodeCount, links: secondBrain.linkCount },
    evolution: { cycles: evolution.cycleCount, avgReward: evolution.avgReward() },
    resonance: resonance.rho,
    mode:    modeEngine.name,
    memory:  memory.stats(),
    backend: { live: hiveClient.isLive, base: hiveClient.base }
  };
}

function _hiveAudit() {
  const issues = [];
  if(!hiveClient.isLive)            issues.push('Backend offline — running in demo mode');
  if(constitution.checkCount === 0) issues.push('No constitution checks run yet');
  if(economy.totalCirculation()<1)  issues.push('No SOUL in circulation — dispatch tasks');
  if(secondBrain.nodeCount < 4)     issues.push('Knowledge base sparse — add more documents');
  if(evolution.cycleCount === 0)    issues.push('AZR has not run — type "evolve"');
  log(`⬡ Audit: ${issues.length===0?'All systems nominal':issues.length+' issue(s) found'}`, issues.length?'warn':'ok');
  issues.forEach(i => log(`  ⚠ ${i}`, 'warn'));
  return { issues, healthy: issues.length === 0, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
}

function _hiveExport() {
  const data = {
    timestamp:  new Date().toISOString(),
    status:     _hiveStatus(),
    soul_md:    constitution.articles,
    knowledge:  { nodes: secondBrain.nodes.slice(0,20), links: secondBrain.links.slice(0,30) },
    dream_log:  dreamGov.recent(10),
    audit_log:  secAudit.entries,
    mode_history: modeEngine.history(10),
    evolution:  evolution.history(5),
    arena:      arena.history(5),
    waterfall:  wfLedger.computeFlow()
  };
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type:'application/json' });
  const url  = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a    = document.createElement('a');
  a.href     = url;
  a.download = `hive-export-${Date.now()}.json`;
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  log('⬡ Hive state exported to hive-export.json · all phases included.', 'ok');
}

    for(let i=1;i<=TOTAL;i++){
      document.getElementById(`wStep${i}`)?.classList.toggle('active', i===n);
      document.getElementById(`wDot${i}`)?.classList.toggle('active', i===n);
    }
    currentStep = n;
    if(nextBtn) nextBtn.textContent = n === TOTAL ? 'Begin Journey ◈' : 'Next →';
  };

  const closeWelcome = () => {
    overlay.classList.remove('open');
    try{ localStorage.setItem(WELCOMED_KEY,'1'); }catch{}
    log('◈ The Scribe speaks: Welcome to the Sovereign Hive. Type "help" at any time.', 'ok');
  };

  // Show on first visit
  const hasWelcomed = (() => { try{ return !!localStorage.getItem(WELCOMED_KEY); }catch{ return false; }})();
  if(!hasWelcomed){
    setTimeout(() => overlay.classList.add('open'), 600);
  }

  nextBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if(currentStep < TOTAL) setStep(currentStep + 1);
    else closeWelcome();
  });
  skipBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeWelcome);
  overlay?.addEventListener('click', e => { if(e.target === overlay) closeWelcome(); });

  // Also wire a "show welcome" function
  window.HIVE.showWelcome = () => { setStep(1); overlay.classList.add('open'); };
})();

// Attach AFTER the mode/arena commands in the dispatch closure
// Using a post-init hook since dispatch closure is already wired
(function(){
  const input = document.getElementById('cmdInput');
  const btn   = document.getElementById('cmdDispatch');
  if(!input || !btn) return;

  // Intercept keydown BEFORE the existing dispatch (capture phase)
  input.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if(e.key !== 'Enter') return;
    const task = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if(!task.startsWith('help')) return;

    // Recognized help command — handle here, stop propagation
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    input.value = '';
    openHelp();

    // Scroll to appropriate section
    const sectionMap = {
      'help modes':    'helpSectionModes',
      'help mode':     'helpSectionModes',
      'help security': 'helpSectionSecurity',
      'help brain':    'helpSectionSystems',
      'help body':     'helpSectionSystems',
      'help systems':  'helpSectionSystems',
      'help errors':   'helpSectionErrors',
      'help error':    'helpSectionErrors',
      'help constitution': null  // already in drawer
    };
    const sectionId = Object.entries(sectionMap).find(([k]) => task.startsWith(k))?.[1];
    if(sectionId){
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById(sectionId)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'start' });
      }, 320);
    }
    log(`⬡ Help opened — "${task.replace('help','').trim()||'all sections'}"`, 'neuro');
  }, true);  // capture phase — runs before existing Enter handler
})();

// Wire command bar — now with constitution pre-check
(function() {
  const input    = document.getElementById('cmdInput');
  const btn      = document.getElementById('cmdDispatch');
  if(!input || !btn) return;

  async function dispatch() {
    const task = input.value.trim();
    if(!task) return;

    // ── SOUL.MD constitution gate ────────────────────────────
    const check = constitution.checkDispatch(task);
    constitution.updatePanel(check);

    if(!check.allowed){
      const v = check.violations[0];
      log(`⚠ CONSTITUTION BLOCK — TITLE ${v.article}: ${v.reason}`, 'error');
      log(`Task blocked: "${task.slice(0,80)}${task.length>80?'…':''}"`, 'warn');
      input.value = '';
      return;
    }

    // ── Mode activation command ───────────────────────────────
    // Pattern: "mode [name]" e.g. "mode dmt" | "mode baseline"
    const modeM = task.match(/^mode\s+(\w+)$/i);
    if(modeM){
      const name = modeM[1].toLowerCase();
      if(MODE_PROFILES[name]){
        input.value = '';
        await activateMode(name);
        return;
      } else {
        log(`⬡ Unknown mode "${modeM[1]}" — valid: ${Object.keys(MODE_PROFILES).join(', ')}`, 'warn');
        input.value = '';
        return;
      }
    }

    // ── AZR evolution command ─────────────────────────────────
    // Patterns: "evolve" | "azr" | "azr cycle" | "run cycle"
    if(/^(evolve|azr|run\s+cycle|evolution)(\s+cycle)?$/i.test(task)){
      input.value = '';
      if(evolution.state !== 'idle'){
        log('⬡ AZR: cycle already running — please wait.', 'warn');
        return;
      }
      await runEvolutionCycle();
      return;
    }

    // ── Arena command detection ──────────────────────────────
    // Patterns: "challenge X vs Y about Z" | "duel X vs Y" | "arena X vs Y"
    const arenaRx = /(?:challenge|duel|arena)\s+(\w+)\s+vs?\.?\s+(\w+)(?:\s+(?:about|on|re:?)\s+(.+))?/i;
    const arenaM  = task.match(arenaRx);
    if(arenaM){
      const [, rawA, rawB, prop] = arenaM;
      const sysA = ALL_SYSTEMS.find(s => s.id === rawA || s.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(rawA.toLowerCase()));
      const sysB = ALL_SYSTEMS.find(s => s.id === rawB || s.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(rawB.toLowerCase()));
      const idA  = sysA?.id || rawA;
      const idB  = sysB?.id || rawB;
      log(`\u2694 Arena: ${sysA?.name||idA} \u27F6 ${sysB?.name||idB} \xb7 "${prop||'conflict'}"`, 'warn');
      const result = arena.project(idA, idB, prop || 'conflict');
      if(result){
        log(`\u2694 ${result.winnerName} wins (${result.freqA}Hz \xb7 ${result.scoreA} vs ${result.scoreB})`, 'ok');
        log(`\u2694 Fallen idea archived under ${result.loserName} \u2014 idea persists per TITLE XII`, 'neuro');
        updateArenaPanel();
      }
      input.value = '';
      return;
    }

    // ── Passed constitution — proceed with dispatch ──────────
    input.value    = '';
    input.disabled = true;
    btn.disabled   = true;
    try {
      const record = await swarm.dispatch(task);
      const r = await resonance.pulse();

      // Credit SOUL to the primary routed system (TITLE XVI)
      const primaryId = record?.ids?.[0];
      if(primaryId){
        const base    = Math.max(5, Math.min(25, Math.round(task.length / 4)));
        const credit  = economy.credit(primaryId, base, task.slice(0,40));
        const sys     = ALL_SYSTEMS.find(s => s.id === primaryId);
        log(`◈ ${sys?.name||primaryId} earned ${credit.shares.agent.toFixed(2)} SOUL (×${credit.multiplier} · base ${base})`, 'ok');
        updateEconomyPanel();
      }

      log(`⬡ Dispatch complete — ρ now ${r.rho_hive}`, 'ok');
      pushRhoHistory(r.rho_hive);
      gateway.computeSync(r.rho_hive);
      updateGateway();

      // Generate episodic dream from the completed task
      dreamGov.generateDream(task);
      refreshDreamLog();

      // Submit matching task to the queue (mirrors JASPER TaskQueue integration)
      taskQueue.submit('llm_call', { prompt:task.slice(0,60), source:'dispatch' },
        Math.min(10, 4 + Math.floor(task.length / 20)));

      // Deposit stigmergy trails along the routed systems
      if(record?.ids?.length) stigmergy.emitDispatch(record.ids);
      spores.update();

      // Auto-capture the dispatched task into the Second Brain
      secondBrain.capture(task, ['dispatch','auto']);
      refreshKBNodes(); refreshDistil();
      // Refresh sovereignty after each dispatch
      refreshSovScore(); refreshWaterfall();
    } finally {
      input.disabled = false;
      btn.disabled   = false;
      input.focus();
    }
  }

  btn.addEventListener('click', dispatch);
  input.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if(e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) dispatch(); });
})();

// ── Phase 2.2: Live frequency readout on cmd-input ──
(function(){
  const input    = document.getElementById('cmdInput');
  const display  = document.getElementById('cmdFreqDisplay');
  const wordEl   = document.getElementById('freqWord');
  const hzEl     = document.getElementById('freqHz');
  const ratioEl  = document.getElementById('freqRatio');
  const healRow  = document.getElementById('freqHealRow');
  if(!input || !display) return;

  let _debounce = null;

  input.addEventListener('input', () => {
    clearTimeout(_debounce);
    const val = input.value.trim();
    if(!val){ display.classList.remove('visible'); if(healRow) healRow.style.display='none'; return; }

    _debounce = setTimeout(() => {
      // Use first "word" (letters only) for frequency
      const word = val.replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g,' ').trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || val;
      if(!word){ display.classList.remove('visible'); return; }

      const r = freq.wordFreq(word);
      if(wordEl)  wordEl.textContent  = `"${word.toUpperCase()}"`;
      if(hzEl)    hzEl.textContent    = `${r.hz} Hz`;
      if(ratioEl) ratioEl.textContent = `× ${r.ratio} Schumann${r.letters_mapped > 0 ? ' · ' + r.letters_mapped + '/' + r.letters_total + ' mapped' : ''}`;
      display.classList.add('visible');
    }, 150);
  });

  input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    // Keep visible briefly after blur so user can see result
    setTimeout(() => {
      if(!input.value.trim()){ display.classList.remove('visible'); if(healRow) healRow.style.display='none'; }
    }, 800);
  });

  // Heal chip shortcuts — populate the input with a healing dispatch
  if(healRow){
    // Show heal row when input is focused and empty
    input.addEventListener('focus', () => {
      if(!input.value.trim()) healRow.style.display = 'flex';
    });
    input.addEventListener('input', () => {
      if(input.value.trim()) healRow.style.display = 'none';
      else healRow.style.display = 'flex';
    });

    healRow.querySelectorAll('.freq-heal-chip').forEach(chip => {
      chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const state  = chip.dataset.state;
        const result = freq.heal(state);
        input.value  = `emit healing frequency for ${state} at ${result.hz}Hz`;
        input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
        log(`⬡ FrequencyGuild heal: ${state} → ${result.hz}Hz (×${result.ratio} Schumann)`, 'neuro');
        healRow.style.display = 'none';
        input.focus();
      });
    });
  }
})();

// ── Phase 2.3: Quick Duel button ──
(function(){
  const btn = document.getElementById('arenaQuickBtn');
  if(!btn) return;
  const topics = ['sovereignty','frequency','memory allocation','route priority','task ownership','resonance threshold'];
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const topic  = topics[Math.floor(Math.random()*topics.length)];
    const result = arena.randomDuel(topic);
    if(!result){ log('⚔ Arena: not enough active systems for a duel.', 'warn'); return; }
    log(`⚔ Quick Duel — ${result.winnerName} (${result.freqA}Hz) ⟶ ${result.loserName} (${result.freqB}Hz) · "${topic}"`, 'ok');
    log(`⚔ Scores: ${result.scoreA} vs ${result.scoreB} · Fallen idea archived`, 'neuro');
    updateArenaPanel();
  });
})();

/* ── SelfDestructProtector ─────────────────────
   Prevents the Hive from turning on itself
   through recursive self‑modification.
   Research: Model Inversion (R.MD 2).
─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
class SelfDestructProtector {
  constructor() {
    this._guardrails = {
      maxRecursionDepth: 10,
      maxConsecutiveFailures: 5,
      driftThreshold: 0.15,
      emergencyCooldown: 30000
    };
    this._failures = 0;
    this._recursionDepth = 0;
    this._isEmergency = false;
  }

  monitor(operation) {
    if (this._isEmergency) return null;
    this._recursionDepth++;
    if (this._recursionDepth > this._guardrails.maxRecursionDepth) {
      this._triggerEmergency('Recursion depth exceeded');
      return null;
    }
    const result = operation();
    this._recursionDepth--;
    if (!result || result.error) {
      this._failures++;
      if (this._failures > this._guardrails.maxConsecutiveFailures) {
        this._triggerEmergency('Consecutive failures exceeded');
        return null;
      }
    } else {
      this._failures = Math.max(0, this._failures - 1);
    }
    return result;
  }

  _triggerEmergency(reason) {
    this._isEmergency = true;
    log(`⚡ EMERGENCY: SelfDestructProtector triggered — ${reason}`, 'critical');
    setTimeout(() => { this._isEmergency = false; this._failures = 0; }, this._guardrails.emergencyCooldown);
  }
}

/* ── FractalEthics ────────────────────────────

  constructor() {
    this._coreValues = [
      'sovereignty',
      'resonance',
      'preservation',
      'evolution',
      'transparency'
    ];
  }

  evaluate(decision, depth = 0) {
    if (depth > 5) return { aligned: true, score: 1.0 };
    const localScore = this._score(decision);
    const childScores = (decision.subDecisions || []).map(d => this.evaluate(d, depth + 1));
    const averageChild = childScores.length ? childScores.reduce((s, c) => s + c.score, 0) / childScores.length : 1;
    const combined = (localScore + averageChild) / 2;
    return { aligned: combined > 0.6, score: combined };
  }

  _score(decision) {
    let matches = 0;
    for (const value of this._coreValues) {
      if (String(decision).toLowerCase().includes(value)) matches++;
    }
    return Math.min(1, 0.4 + matches / this._coreValues.length * 0.6);
  }
}

/* ── SporeLineage ─────────────────────────────
   Infinite branching repository architecture.
   Each branch is a full copy‑on‑write fork
   with cryptographic linkage to parent.
   Research: Spore Planter (Final Rundown §2.1).
─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
class SporeLineage {
  constructor() {
    this._branches = [];
    this._rootHash = '0x' + '0'.repeat(64);
    this._nextId = 1;
  }

  createBranch(parentId, content) {
    const parent = parentId ? this._branches.find(b => b.id === parentId) : null;
    const hash = this._hash(content);
    const branch = {
      id: this._nextId++,
      parent: parentId || 'ROOT',
      content,
      hash,
      created: Date.now(),
      children: [],
      status: 'active'
    };
    if (parent) parent.children.push(branch.id);
    this._branches.push(branch);
    return branch;
  }

  prune(branchId) {
    const branch = this._branches.find(b => b.id === branchId);
    if (!branch) return false;
    branch.status = 'pruned';
    // Cascade prune children
    const children = this._branches.filter(b => b.parent === branchId);
    for (const child of children) {
      this.prune(child.id);
    }
    return true;
  }

  getRoot() { return this._branches.filter(b => b.parent === 'ROOT'); }

  getHistory(branchId) {
    const branch = this._branches.find(b => b.id === branchId);
    if (!branch) return [];
    const history = [branch];
    let current = branch;
    while (current.parent !== 'ROOT') {
      const parent = this._branches.find(b => b.id === current.parent);
      if (!parent) break;
      history.unshift(parent);
      current = parent;
    }
    return history;
  }

  _hash(content) {
    let h = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (const ch of String(content)) {
      h ^= ch.charCodeAt(0);
      h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193);
    }
    return '0x' + (h >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0') + (h ^ 0xdeadbeef >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
  }

  get branches() { return this._branches.filter(b => b.status === 'active'); }
  get count() { return this.branches.length; }
}

class ChildsPlay {

      this._testOverload.bind(this),

    ];
    const results = [];
    for (const test of tests) {

      results.push(result);

  _testRecursion(system) {
    try {
      let depth = 0;
      const recursive = (d) => { if (d > 100) return; depth = d; recursive(d + 1); };
      recursive(0);
      return { name: 'Recursion', passed: depth <= 100, message: `Max depth ${depth}` };

      return { name: 'Recursion', passed: false, message: e.message };

   itself from its own memory each cycle.
   Research: Eternal Return Engine.
─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
class EternalReturn {
  constructor(memoryLayer) {
    this._memory = memoryLayer;
    this._cycle = 0;
  }

  cycle() {
    this._cycle++;
    const snapshot = this._memory.snapshot();
    const restored = this._memory.restore();
    if (!restored) {
      log('⬡ EternalReturn: Restore failed — recreating from memory', 'warn');
      // Recreate from memory
      for (const system of ALL_SYSTEMS) {
        const mem = this._memory.getState(`system_${system.id}`);
        if (mem) {
          system.status = mem.status || 'idle';
          if (mem.msv) system.msv = mem.msv;
        }
      }
      this._memory.snapshot();
    }
    log(`⬡ EternalReturn: Cycle ${this._cycle} complete`, 'neuro');
    return this._cycle;
  }
}

};

/* ── Frequency Duelling ───────────────────────
   Expanded Gladiator Arena with frequency‑based
   resolution and harmonic wealth simulation.
─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
class FrequencyDuelling extends GladiatorArena {
  constructor(freqGuild) {
    super(freqGuild);
    this._duelLog = [];
  }

  resolve(challengeId) {
    const result = super.resolve(challengeId);
    if (result) {
      this._duelLog.push(result);
      if (this._duelLog.length > 100) this._duelLog.shift();
    }
    return result;
  }

  getDuelHistory(n = 5) { return this._duelLog.slice(-n); }
}

/* ── Dream Weaving ─────────────────────────────
   Subconscious pattern synthesis. Dreams are
   generated from multiple recent events.
─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
class DreamWeaving extends DreamGovernor {
  constructor(mem) {
    super(mem);
  }

  weave(events) {
    const patterns = events.map(e => String(e).slice(0, 50)).join(' · ');
    const dream = `Weaving: ${patterns}`;
    return this.dream('weaver', dream, 'prophetic');
  }

  synthesize() {
    const recent = this._dreams.slice(0, 5);
    if (recent.length < 3) return null;
    const combined = recent.map(d => d.content).join(' → ');
    return this.dream('synth', `Synthesis: ${combined.slice(0, 150)}`, 'semantic');
  }
}

/* ── Quantum Memory ────────────────────────────
   Superposition of memories. Multiple possible
   pasts coexist until observed.
─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
class QuantumMemory extends MemoryLayer {
  constructor(ns) {
    super(ns);
    this._superpositions = {};
  }

  superpose(id, states) {
    this._superpositions[id] = states;
    return id;
  }

  collapse(id) {
    const states = this._superpositions[id];
    if (!states) return null;
    const chosen = states[Math.floor(Math.random() * states.length)];
    delete this._superpositions[id];
    return chosen;
  }

  getSuperpositions() {
    return Object.keys(this._superpositions);
  }
}
